jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.summary: Absolute Business Solutions Corp (ABSC) is not just another tech company. We’re a community of innovators, engineers, analysts and business professionals working together with our customers to tackle the most complex national security challenges. For more...
jobs.description:
Absolute Business Solutions Corp (ABSC) is not just another tech company. We’re a community of innovators, engineers, analysts and business professionals working together with our customers to tackle the most complex national security challenges. For more than 20 years we’ve supported critical Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), Federal Civilian missions and global, multi-national corporations. We specialize in supporting our clients in the Intelligence, Technology, Defense, AI/ML, and Data Science fields. As we continue to grow at a rapid pace, we need some amazing new professionals to join our team.

ABSC is seeking an **IT Systems Engineer** to join our team supporting the Air Force National Capital Region (AFNCR) Information Technology Services (ITS2) program, delivering secure, resilient technology supporting Air Force operations across the National Capital Region, including the Pentagon, Joint Base Andrews, and Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling. Spanning cybersecurity, engineering, enterprise operations, infrastructure modernization, logistics, and 24/7 mission support, AFNCR ITS2 also supports the National Military Command Center (NMCC), Joint Staff, and other mission partners—giving technical professionals the opportunity to solve complex challenges while helping keep critical national-defense capabilities connected, protected, and operational.

As an **IT Systems Engineer**, you will design, implement, maintain, and modernize information technology systems supporting the AFDW mission. You will work across engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, network, and operations teams to translate mission and technical requirements into secure, reliable solutions—from architecture and design through integration, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support.

The majority of work is conducted on-site at our client location in the National Capital Region – primarily Pentagon, Joint Base Andrews and/or Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling (JBAB), based on each assignment. We offer a flexible schedule and, occasionally, some tasks may be performed remotely with prior client approval.

**Security clearance required for this role:** An Active Secret security clearance is required.

**Responsibilities:**

The IT Systems Engineer will support activities including:

- Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot information technology systems and supporting infrastructure.
- Develop technical solutions that address customer and mission requirements across computing, network, platform, and enterprise environments.
- Design and maintain computing infrastructure necessary to support key mission and operational requirements.
- Establish and implement networking and system configurations consistent with cybersecurity and information assurance requirements.
- Troubleshoot network errors, system performance issues, integration challenges, and other complex technical problems.
- Support the design, integration, installation, testing, deployment, sustainment, and lifecycle management of new and existing IT systems and services.
- Develop engineering solutions incorporating applicable cybersecurity and security controls.
- Analyze technical requirements and alternatives and provide recommendations for system architecture, infrastructure, hardware, software, and technology solutions.
- Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, mission partners, service providers, cybersecurity teams, network administrators, system administrators, data center personnel, and program offices.
- Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture diagrams, network diagrams, engineering plans, configurations, implementation documentation, and other technical artifacts.
- Support Assessment and Authorization (A&A) activities by developing and maintaining required engineering and system documentation.
- Support configuration management activities and ensure systems, infrastructure, and associated configuration items are accurately documented and maintained.
- Evaluate and incorporate emerging technologies, including virtualization, cloud computing, Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS), when appropriate to mission requirements.
- Support technology modernization, lifecycle management, system upgrades, hardware and software refresh, and change management activities.
- Apply DoD, Air Force, industry, and engineering standards and best practices throughout the system development and sustainment lifecycle.
- Assist with outage resolution and technical troubleshooting to maintain system availability, reliability, and mission readiness.

**Requirements:**

- **Education/Years’ Experience/Certifications:**
- **Option 1 – Standard Qualification**
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
- Minimum 5 years’ relevant experience
- **Option 2 – Master's Degree Substitution**
- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
- Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.
- **Option 3 - Experience Substitution**
- **N**o degree required with a minimum of 10 years of intensive and progressive experience demonstrating the required technical proficiency for the position.
- **Skills:**
- Strong understanding of enterprise IT systems, infrastructure, networking, and systems engineering principles.
- Ability to design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot complex IT environments.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop effective technical solutions.
- Ability to translate customer and mission requirements into practical technical solutions.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical architecture, system, configuration, and engineering documentation.
- Ability to work effectively across engineering, cybersecurity, network, infrastructure, operations, and program teams.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a highly regulated DoD environment.
- Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.
- On-call or after-hours support may be required based on mission needs.

**Desired Skills:**

Strong candidates will have hands-on experience with one or more of the following:

- Enterprise systems engineering and integration
- Windows and/or Linux environments
- Network architecture and infrastructure
- Server and virtualization technologies
- VMware or equivalent virtualization platforms
- Cloud computing and cloud infrastructure
- IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments
- Active Directory and enterprise services
- System architecture and engineering documentation
- Network and system troubleshooting
- Configuration management and change management
- Hardware and software lifecycle management
- DISA STIGs and DoD cybersecurity requirements
- Risk Management Framework (RMF) environments
- NIPRNet and/or SIPRNet environments
- DoD and Air Force enterprise IT environments
- Systems monitoring and performance management
- Technology modernization and infrastructure refresh

Salary is commensurate with education and years’ experience. Salary range for this requisition is: $90k-$150k annual.

**Who we are:**
ABSC is a technology and services company that combines the agility of a small business with proven processes refined over more than two decades in business. We specialize in supporting public sector clients in the Intelligence, Defense, Health, and Safety areas. Our team stands ready to deliver the next generation of programs, personnel, and solutions to help advance our federal government customers’ driving innovation, agility, and security across all mission areas.

**Some of our benefits include:**

- Generous PTO plus 11 Federal Holidays
- Retirement Planning – 401k Fully Vested with Match
- Annual Health and Wellness Allowance – buy an Apple Watch, a treadmill, or hit the gym on us
- Career Development – Annual Funds to spend on Education and Training
- Volunteer Time Off – Annually, all employees can spend 8 hours directly supporting a charity of choice
- Charitable Match – ABSC matches an employee’s donation to a qualifying charity
- Referral Program – We pay for internal and external referrals!
- LOV Awards – Earn bonus awards throughout the year from our Living Our Values awards program

Apply to join our team today! We are always looking to grow our team - if you know someone who is seeking a new career opportunity, please share this job opening with them. ABSC offers generous external referral bonuses. You don’t need to be an employee to benefit from our Referral Program.

\*ABSC is a proud V3, Virginia Values Vets, member which recognizes our commitment to hiring Veterans. If you are a veteran, please be sure to include that in your application.\*

Equal Opportunity Employer, including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the **Best Places to Work** in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a **Best Places to Work** honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the **Inc. 5000** list of fastest-growing companies in America in **2022, 2023, and 2025**, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

The Endpoint Engineer – AI Desktop Deployment is responsible for designing, deploying, securing, and maintaining enterprise Windows endpoints that support AI-enabled desktop capabilities in highly regulated, government, and Zero Trust environments. This role combines traditional Windows desktop engineering with modern endpoint management, security compliance, application deployment, performance optimization, and device health monitoring.

The engineer will work closely with cybersecurity, cloud, identity, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure endpoints are secure, compliant, performant, and ready to support AI-enabled applications and workloads. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Windows 10/11, Group Policy, application packaging, and Zero Trust endpoint controls.

### **Job Responsibilities**

- Perform enterprise desktop engineering for Windows 10 and Windows 11, including operating system configuration, deployment, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.
- Administer and engineer Microsoft Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager environments for device enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, and endpoint security.
- Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs) supporting enterprise security, configuration, and operational requirements.
- Establish and maintain standardized Windows endpoint configurations, deployment methodologies, and engineering documentation.
- Develop and maintain Windows provisioning and deployment solutions, including Autopilot and automated device enrollment where applicable.
- Evaluate Windows updates, feature releases, drivers, firmware, and endpoint configuration changes before production deployment.
- Support endpoint modernization efforts and migration from legacy endpoint-management technologies to cloud-managed or hybrid-management architectures.
- Automate repetitive endpoint administration and configuration tasks using PowerShell and other approved scripting technologies.

### **Job Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
- Experience deploying Microsoft Copilot, AI assistants, or other enterprise AI desktop applications.
- Familiarity with enterprise AI governance, data-loss prevention, information protection, and access-control considerations for generative AI tools.
- Experience evaluating endpoint hardware and software readiness for AI-enabled workloads.
- Familiarity with Windows AI capabilities, AI-enabled productivity platforms, or locally executed AI workloads.
- Experience integrating endpoint-management telemetry with security, identity, IT operations, or SIEM platforms.
- Experience with Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Graph, PowerShell automation, or proactive remediation technologies.

**Government Cloud & Zero Trust Responsibilities**

- Implement and maintain device compliance and Conditional Access controls supporting the Zero Trust device pillar.
- Engineer, deploy, and maintain STIG-compliant endpoint security baselines for Windows systems.
- Apply and maintain DISA STIG, organizational security baseline, and applicable federal endpoint-hardening requirements.
- Configure Intune compliance policies, configuration profiles, endpoint security policies, and security baselines for government environments.
- Support endpoint-management capabilities within applicable Microsoft Government Cloud environments, including GCC, GCC High, or related environments as required.
- Integrate endpoint posture and device-compliance signals with identity and access-control solutions.
- Ensure only authorized, managed, compliant, and appropriately secured devices can access protected enterprise resources.
- Implement endpoint controls supporting Zero Trust principles including device identity, continuous verification, least privilege, and risk-based access.
- Coordinate with identity teams on Microsoft Entra ID device registration, join models, Conditional Access, and authentication requirements.
- Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent endpoint detection, security telemetry, vulnerability-management, and response capabilities.
- Remediate endpoint vulnerabilities, configuration findings, compliance exceptions, and security control deficiencies.
- Assist with evidence collection and technical documentation supporting security assessments, audits, authorization activities, and continuous monitoring.
- Support endpoint configurations aligned with applicable NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP, CISA, DoD, or agency-specific security requirements, as applicable to the environment.

**Preferred Certifications:**

- Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) — strongly desired.
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner — desired only if the position supports or integrates with AWS environments.

We’re actively searching for talented security and technology practitioners who are ready to experience the True Zero difference. As a True Zero team member, you'll enjoy:

- Competitive salary, paid twice per month

- Best in class medical coverage

- 100% of medical premiums covered by True Zero

- Company wide new business incentive programs

- Contribution Incentives (i.e. white papers, blog posts, internal webinars, etc.)

- 3 weeks of PTO starting + 11 Paid Holidays Annually

- 401k Program with 100% company match on the first 4%

- Monthly reimbursement of Cell Phone and Home Internet costs

- Paternity/Maternity Leave

- Investment in training and certifications to broaden and deepen your technical skills

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

- Identify recurring issues, monitoring gaps, failed recoveries, job failures, and process inefficiencies, then lead permanent fixes or automation improvements.

**Experience you’ll need to have:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent education, related experience, and/or military experience.
- 2+ years of experience in enterprise-level support, cybersecurity operations, system administration, SaaS platforms, cloud environments, infrastructure operations, platform monitoring, O/S patching, batch/job monitoring, or production support.
- Experience with ITSM tools and workflows, including incident, problem, change, request, request queue, escalation, and service validation management.
- Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to assess alerts, gather evidence, identify impact, execute standard recovery steps, validate completion, and escalate appropriately.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings, risks, decisions, actions, outcomes, and follow-up items clearly.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

- Experience with monitoring and observability concepts such as SRE Golden Signals, HTTP/API test creation, synthetic monitoring, validation logic, content assertions, dashboards, alert thresholds, event correlation, alert tuning, and incident automation.
- Familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Moogsoft, Splunk, Dynatrace, ThousandEyes, CloudWatch, Grafana, Tanium, scheduler tools, or similar platforms.
- Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Linux/Unix concepts, web services, cloud or hybrid infrastructure, networking, TLS/SSL certificates, certificate management, API troubleshooting, batch scheduling, and job dependencies.
- Familiarity with automation, scripting, synthetic script development, or automated validation concepts using tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, or automated recovery workflows.
- Preferred exposure to Public Key Infrastructure, certificate lifecycle management, key management systems, identity platforms, endpoint security, vulnerability management, disaster recovery procedures, failover support, or related cybersecurity technologies.

jobs.summary: Life-Science Innovations has a full-time opportunity for a **Sr. End User Computing Engineer / Telecommunication Engineer** to join their team. This position leads the strategy, management, security, and modernization of the organization’s endpoint...
jobs.description:
Life-Science Innovations has a full-time opportunity for a **Sr. End User Computing Engineer / Telecommunication Engineer** to join their team. This position leads the strategy, management, security, and modernization of the organization’s endpoint environment, including workstations, mobile devices, endpoint tools, and user technology services. This role focuses on advancing endpoint management through technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Endpoint Central, patching, encryption, compliance, application deployment, and endpoint security. Working closely with IT teams, vendors, and business partners, this position develops secure, scalable, and supportable solutions that improve device governance, lifecycle management, and the overall end-user technology experience, while also supporting select telecom and Teams Phone responsibilities.

Our goal at LSI is to provide tailored professional shared services to each of our customers, partnering with them to become an extension of their team. Headquartered in Willmar, MN, on the beautiful MinnWest Technology Campus, Life-Science Innovations employs people in a variety of roles and expertise. We hire technically passionate, positive, career minded individuals who align with our core organizational values.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

- Serve as the senior technical owner for endpoint management platforms, standards, and processes across workstations and mobile devices.
- Design, implement, and optimize endpoint management using Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Endpoint Central, Entra ID, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365.
- Establish and maintain device provisioning standards, configuration baselines, compliance policies, and workstation lifecycle processes.
- Lead Windows upgrades, device replacements, application deployment, patching, enrollment, and advanced endpoint troubleshooting.
- Strengthen endpoint security through BitLocker, device hardening, vulnerability remediation, compliance, and CIS-aligned configurations.
- Partner with IT leadership, security, systems, and service desk teams to improve endpoint security, support processes, escalation paths, and overall efficiency.
- Evaluate endpoint and user technology solutions, vendors, licensing, and tools based on security, usability, cost, and long-term fit.
- Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, processes, and support procedures to create a consistent, scalable environment.
- Collaborate with business partners and remote sites to translate technology needs into practical, secure, and supportable solutions.
- Support select telecom and Teams Phone services, including cellular devices, phones, conference room technology, carriers, and vendors.
- Participate in IT projects, change management, ITSM processes, and cross-functional initiatives impacting end-user technology.

**The ideal candidate will have the following educational and experience background:**

- 8+ years of progressive IT experience with significant experience in endpoint administration, desktop engineering, systems administration, or related roles.
- Experience managing Windows endpoints and endpoint management platforms, including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, SCCM/Endpoint Configuration Manager, Endpoint Central, or similar.
- Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, networking, and end-user technologies.
- Strong understanding of endpoint security, including encryption, vulnerability remediation, device compliance, configuration baselines, conditional access, and least-privilege principles.
- Demonstrated ability to operate at a senior technical level, making sound decisions, evaluating risk, and balancing security, usability, scalability, supportability, and cost.
- Experience developing and maintaining endpoint standards, processes, device provisioning, application deployment, patching, compliance, and workstation lifecycle management.
- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving, and customer service skills, with the ability to resolve complex endpoint and user technology issues.
- Excellent communication, documentation, organization, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with IT teams, vendors, business leaders, and end users.
- Ability to work independently, identify risks and opportunities, make recommendations, and translate business needs into practical, secure, and supportable technology solutions.
- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
- Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate or similar certification preferred.

**Success in This Role Looks Like:**

- Endpoint standards are clear, secure, documented, and repeatable.
- Workstations and mobile devices are easier to deploy, manage, patch, secure, and support.
- Intune, Autopilot, Endpoint Central, and related tools are used in a practical, governed, and supportable way.
- Security gaps related to endpoints are identified, prioritized, and steadily reduced.
- Service Desk and Systems teams have better documentation, escalation paths, and support processes.
- Local customers receive practical, responsive, and professional support.
- Telecom and cellular responsibilities are handled reliably without distracting from the larger endpoint modernization mission.
- The organization continues moving from reactive endpoint support toward planned, secure, scalable endpoint management.

**Work Location and Travel:**

- Hybrid position within driving distance of Willmar, MN.
- Minimum of two days per week onsite.
- Regular onsite engagement with local customers is expected, including recurring 1:1s, site visits, and project/support coordination.
- Occasional travel to other company locations may be required.
- Some locations may include office, production, farm, hatchery, or field environments with exposure to dust, dirt, noise, temperature variation, and other normal site conditions.

**Pay:**$98,000 - $122,500 Annually

***Our Purpose is to Share Smarter, Serve Better - By providing tailored professional shared services, partnering with our customers to become an extension of their team.***

**Our Guiding Values:**

- **Employee Well-Being:** We are committed to maximizing every employee’s talent in their role within the organization, and care about the well-being of each employee from a whole-life perspective.
- **Communication | Collaboration:** Success is built on relationships. We will bring expertise, professionalism and a genuine love for our craft to the table – and expect the same in return.
- **Stewardship:** Our investment of time, talent, and treasure will do great things in the long run. We make decisions based on our responsibility to our employees, our customers, our stakeholders and our community.
- **Trustworthiness:** There are no substitutes for honesty and kindness and doing what’s right.
- **Excellence:** We are persistent in achieving objectives efficiently and effectively; finding new ways to grow our company and each other

**Benefits at LSI:**
We are proud to offer a generous benefit package in addition to competitive compensation. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance options, a Health Savings Account with company match, 401K plan with company match up to 4% of your compensation, PTO accrual, two personal days per year, holiday pay, company paid short and long term disability, and company paid life insurance.

**To Apply or Further Inquire Contact:**
Rachel Weiss | Talent Acquisition Specialist
Rachel.Weiss@life-scienceinnovations.com
(320) 222-9790

jobs.description:
**Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?**
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

**Pay and Benefits:**

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
- Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
- Pension / Retirement benefits
- Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
- DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact you will have in this role:**

Being a member of IT Enterprise Architecture Data & Corp Tech team, the Lead Infrastructure Test Engineer – Endpoint Testing & Automation will lead the design, execution, automation, and continuous improvement of enterprise endpoint and servers validation for accelerated patch and application release cycles. this role is accountable for enabling ETE certification within a short testing SLA after deployment and release. The role will drive automated functional, regression, standard application, and performance testing using Login VSI and custom automation frameworks while ensuring measurable quality gates, actionable defect triage, and leadership-ready reporting across Laptop, VDI, VM, Windows laptop, VDI server and macOS environments.

The Enterprise Infrastructure End-to-End Testing (ETE) function validates endpoint readiness, stability, user experience, application functionality, and performance across VDI, Azure Persistent VM, Windows laptop, and macOS platforms following monthly patches, security updates, application upgrades, and emergency releases. The team partners with DWS Stakeholders to deliver rapid, evidence-based certification of enterprise endpoints while reducing user-impact risk.

**Your Primary Responsibilities:**

- Own and lead enterprise ETE endpoint and VDI assets validation across VDI, vPod, Windows laptops, VDI servers, and macOS following OS patches, security updates, application/agent upgrades, and business releases.
- Deliver accelerated testing SLAs \ by defining prioritized execution models, entry/exit criteria, automation runbooks, and rapid defect triage workflows. Provide fast, evidence-based release certification including pass/fail status, defect classification, risk assessment, and go/no-go recommendations in collaboration with DWS stakeholders.
- Drive unified functional, regression, and performance validation using standardized ETE test cases and Login VSI workloads to benchmark user experience, application response, and capacity impact.
- Design, build, and scale automation frameworks leveraging Python, PowerShell, APIs, and command-line tooling to automate endpoint validation, health checks, application testing, telemetry capture, and evidence generation.
- Standardize performance and experience validation by tracking CPU, memory, disk, logon time, application response, and Login VSI deltas against baseline metrics.
- Develop cross-platform validation workflows, including macOS testing for patch readiness, compliance, authentication, application behavior, security agent compatibility, and performance baselining.
- Perform deep OS and application troubleshooting across Windows environments, including event logs, services, drivers, kernel/CPU scheduling, memory/disk performance, network stack behavior, login delays, and endpoint agent conflicts. Leverage observability platforms (e.g., SysTrack, Login VSI, Event Viewer, PerfMon) to accelerate defect identification, root cause analysis, and impact quantification.
- Operate patch-cycle command center execution with defined ownership, severity models, escalation paths, and structured communication cadence for compressed release timelines.
- Establish automation-first, repeatable test execution models to increase coverage, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and eliminate false positives.
- Identify and escalate critical defects early with actionable telemetry, reproducible evidence, impact scope, and remediation ownership.
- Deliver leadership-ready reporting and dashboards covering SLA adherence, automation coverage, pass/fail trends, performance impact, defect aging, and enterprise risk exposure
- Continuously improve the ETE testing ecosystem by driving automation maturity, proactive risk detection, standardized execution, and measurable quality improvements.
- Ensure audit-ready compliance and control adherence, maintaining documented validation evidence, patch readiness metrics, and vulnerability remediation alignment.

***\*\*NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. \*\****

**Qualifications:**

- Minimum of 6+ years of relevant experience
- Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed for Success:**

- 6–10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, endpoint testing, endpoint management, VDI operations, EUC engineering, QA automation, or enterprise technology operations.
- Hands-on experience validating enterprise endpoints including Windows laptops, VDI, vPod, and macOS devices after patching, application upgrades, security agent updates, and platform changes.
- Strong Windows operating system troubleshooting knowledge including logs, services, drivers, kernel/CPU behavior, memory/disk performance, networking, profiles, login experience, and endpoint agent interactions.
- Experience performing functional, regression, application, compatibility, and performance testing using standardized test cases and enterprise testing tools.
- Hands-on experience with Login VSI or comparable user-experience/performance testing toolsets for virtual desktop or application performance validation.
- Strong automation experience with Python, with working knowledge of C#, C++, PowerShell, REST/API integration, and command-line automation for endpoint validation and evidence collection.
- Working knowledge of SCCM/MECM and/or Microsoft Intune patch deployment processes, endpoint readiness models, and post-deployment validation workflows.
- Basic-to-intermediate application troubleshooting skills, including application launch, functional validation, crash/hang review, dependency validation, and performance symptom analysis.
- Experience with observability or DEX platforms such as SysTrack/Lakeside, endpoint telemetry, Windows Event Viewer, PerfMon, WMI/CIM, and log analytics is preferred.
- Mac endpoint validation experience including macOS patching, application validation, security tool compatibility, compliance posture, authentication/login flows, and performance checks is preferred.
- Ability to lead engineers, assign ownership, coordinate with cross-functional teams, manage priorities during compressed release windows, and produce executive-ready status reporting.
- Experience working in regulated enterprise environments with documented change validation, risk controls, audit evidence, and ITIL-aligned operational practices is preferred.

**Preferred:**

- Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Citrix DaaS, hybrid endpoint environments, and cloud-managed endpoint platforms.
- Exposure to endpoint security and productivity agents such as CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Qualys, Defender, SysTrack, Sapience, Cisco Secure Client, and similar enterprise agents.
- Experience building dashboards or automated reporting for SLA compliance, patch readiness, automation execution, defect trends, and performance regression analysis.
- Familiarity with AI-assisted or autonomous testing concepts, test orchestration, and continuous improvement of enterprise regression testing platforms.

*The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.*

jobs.description:
**Empath Health** is seeking a **Desktop Support Administrator** is responsible for providing technical support and maintaining desktop and mobile device systems for colleagues within their service area and as needed, across the organization. This position involves installing software and updates, configuring system settings, and troubleshooting hardware and software issues. The Desktop Support Administrator responds to incoming ticket requests, calls, and walk-in requests and when needed, travels to other sites to provide on-site, deskside support to the client. In addition, this position will perform service desk functions, on-site functionals tasks, and be available to support clients through participation in on-call rotation.

**Must live local with the ability to work on-site and travel between locations as needed.**

**What you'll Do**

- Applies technical knowledge to support end-users for desktops, laptops, and mobile devices as well as telecom services, email service, and all IT client provided services.
- Creates and implements solutions to correct and prevent ongoing systems issues, to minimize disruptions to the productivity of the end-user.
- Performs physical inventory of laptops and other equipment, accessories, and parts to ensure configuration and inventory management database entries are complete and accurate.
- Participates in on-call rotation.
- May be required to travel between facilities.

**Why Join Empath Health?**

- **Earn Competitive Pay:** Your skills and contributions are recognized and rewarded.
- **Benefits & Wellness:** Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement with company match, plus wellness programs to support your mind and body.
- **Industry-Leading PTO:** 5+ weeks to rest, recharge, and live your Full Life.
- **Grow Your Career:** CEU support, tuition reimbursement, and advancement opportunities.
- **Make a Difference:** Join a mission-driven team dedicated to kindness, compassion, and Full Life Care for All.

**What You'll Need**

- Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer science or related field with 3 or more years of experience in a corporate Information Technology department providing end-user support over a wide range of systems. Or, an equivalent level of education and experience.
- Microsoft Certification on Office Applications, Windows, 7, 8, and/or 10 strongly preferred.; CompTia A+ Certification strongly preferred.
- Knowledge and experience with Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) reference model.
- Experience with end-user IT support (e.g., Windows operating systems, PC hardware, antivirus tools. personal firewall tools, web browser, MS Office applications).
- Must be available for and participate in on-call rotation overnight and weekends.
- Ability to work on-site and travel between locations as needed. Has a valid active driver’s license, reliable transportation, and auto insurance.

##### **What You’ll Find at Empath Health**

**Unified in empathy, we serve our communities through extraordinary Full Life Care for All.**

Empath Health is a not-for-profit healthcare organization providing **Full Life Care** through a connected network of services across Florida, including hospice, home health, grief care, geriatric primary care, elder care (PACE), HIV and sexual health (EPIC), and dementia support.

Full Life Care means caring for the **whole person, body, mind, and spirit, with empathy and dignity.** Our care goes beyond medicine to help people feel seen, supported, and valued at every stage of life.

At Empath Health, you’ll find **purpose, partnership, and possibility** in a culture where compassion drives excellence and every team member helps make life’s journey more meaningful.

# **Digital Workplace Engineer (m/w/d) – M365 Collaboration & Adoption**

## **LAPP**

Wir bei LAPP sind ein Familienunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Stuttgart und führend in der Kabel- und Verbindungstechnologie. Gegründet 1959, befinden wir uns bis heute vollständig in Familienbesitz. Mit rund 5.700 Mitarbeitenden sind wir in über 80 Ländern aktiv – global vernetzt und regional verwurzelt. jobs.description:
You have a clear vision of where your career can go. And we have the leadership to help you get there. At CNA, we strive to create a culture in which people know they matter and are part of something important, ensuring the abilities of all employees are used to their fullest potential.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Azure Technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) to serve as a central technical authority for CNA's Azure cloud environment. This role is primarily focused on enabling and supporting Managed Service Providers (MSPs) through expert technical guidance, hands-on oversight, and acting as the primary escalation point for complex Azure issues.

The Azure Technical SME will collaborate closely with CNA's Security and Architecture teams to uphold and advance the organization's security posture and enforce approved architectural patterns. They will partner with Application and Business teams to facilitate the deployment and provisioning of key Azure services at scale, including Microsoft Power Platform and Power BI, ensuring solutions are delivered securely, efficiently, and in alignment with enterprise standards.

Additionally, this role will work in close partnership with CNA's AI Governance and Digital Workplace Enablement teams to ensure the smooth, compliant, and scalable deployment of AI technologies from both Azure and infrastructure perspectives. The Azure Technical SME will also champion cloud cost management and FinOps practices, driving financial accountability, spend transparency, and optimization across Azure services and MSP-delivered workloads.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, and enterprise security architectures, with a strong focus on automation, governance, scalability, and cost optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. MSP Technical Guidance & Escalation Support

- Serve as the primary technical point of contact and escalation resource for CNA's Managed Service Providers (MSPs) across Azure cloud operations.

- Provide expert technical guidance on Azure platform capabilities, service configurations, and best practices to MSP teams.

- Review and validate MSP-proposed solutions and change requests against CNA's architectural standards and security requirements.

- Monitor MSP delivery quality, identify gaps or risks, and intervene with targeted guidance or remediation direction.

- Facilitate structured knowledge transfer sessions and technical workshops to uplift MSP capability and alignment.

- Coordinate escalation paths and resolution timelines for critical Azure incidents, working with MSPs and internal teams to drive rapid resolution.

- Maintain clear documentation of escalation outcomes, architectural decisions, and operational standards for MSP engagement.

2. Azure Platform Guidance and Governance

- Provide SME oversight for Azure landing zones, subscriptions, resource groups, networking, identity integration, policy controls, role-based access, and platform governance.

- Guide the use of Azure services including compute, storage, networking, monitoring, backup, automation, and platform management capabilities.

- Ensure Azure services are designed and provisioned using approved CNA architecture patterns, security baselines, naming standards, tagging standards, and operational controls.

- Partner with Architecture to evaluate new Azure services and determine the right adoption path, guardrails, and support model.

- Support cloud cost management, including budget tracking, consumption reviews, forecasting, tagging compliance, cost allocation, and optimization recommendations in partnership with MSPs, Finance, and service owners.

- Provide guidance on Azure cost controls, including reserved capacity, savings plans, right-sizing, lifecycle policies, unused resource cleanup, and showback or chargeback reporting where appropriate.

- Evaluate and implement emerging Azure services to improve platform capabilities and operational efficiency.

- Develop endpoint standards, deployment strategies, and governance processes.

- Automate endpoint provisioning, software deployment, and compliance reporting.

3. Security & Compliance

- Partner with the CNA Security team to implement, validate, and continuously improve the organization's Azure security posture.

- Engage with the CNA Architecture team to define, enforce, and evolve approved Azure architectural patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures.

- Ensure all Azure services, deployments, and configurations adhere to CNA's security baselines, compliance frameworks, and governance standards.

- Conduct regular architecture and security reviews of Azure environments, identifying and driving remediation of gaps or deviations.

- Contribute to the development of Azure security policies, standards, and control frameworks in alignment with regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC 2, NIST, PCI-DSS).

- Collaborate on Zero Trust strategy and implementation across Azure infrastructure and services.

- Serve as a technical subject matter resource in security assessments, audits, and risk reviews related to Azure.

4. AI Technology Enablement & Infrastructure Support

- Collaborate with CNA's AI Governance team to ensure AI technologies and services deployed via Azure comply with governance frameworks, policies, and ethical standards.

- Partner with the Digital Workplace Enablement team to support the smooth deployment and adoption of AI-powered capabilities (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot) from an infrastructure and platform perspective.

- Provide technical guidance on Azure AI/ML infrastructure requirements including networking, identity, data residency, and security for AI workloads.

- Assist in evaluating and onboarding Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI Service, AI Foundry, Cognitive Services) within CNA's approved architecture.

- Ensure AI service deployments adhere to CNA's data governance, privacy, and security requirements.

- Serve as a technical bridge between AI product teams, infrastructure teams, and governance stakeholders to resolve deployment blockers and streamline delivery.

- Contribute to AI readiness assessments and infrastructure planning for enterprise-scale AI initiatives.

5. Operations & Continuous Improvement

- Develop monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards for Azure and Microsoft 365 services.

- Automate routine administrative and operational processes using PowerShell, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, and related tools.

- Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational runbooks.

- Provide Level 4 technical support and serve as an escalation point for complex cloud and workplace issues.

- Mentor MSP engineers and administrators on Azure, Microsoft 365, and endpoint management best practices.

- Identify opportunities for operational improvement, automation, and service modernization.

- Participate in project planning, architecture reviews, and technology roadmaps.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:

- Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to follow structured troubleshooting approaches.

- Ability to learn new technologies and processes efficiently in a regulated enterprise environment.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical partners.

- Strong attention to detail and adherence to security, compliance, and operational standards.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and service requests in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience creating or updating technical documentation and operational procedures.

- Demonstrated technical aptitude with an interest in continuous learning and development.

- Proven experience designing and supporting enterprise-scale Azure and Modern Workplace environments.

**Strong knowledge of:**

- Azure Compute, Storage, Networking, and Identity Services

- Azure Landing Zones

- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM)

- Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager

- Microsoft 365 Administration

- Microsoft Defender Security Solutions

- Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

- Strong understanding of cloud governance, operational excellence, and cost optimization practices.

**Education and Experience:**

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- Typically a minimum of 10 years of progressive IT infrastructure, cloud, or workplace technology experience.

- Typically 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering and administration experience.

- Excellent communication, leadership, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, LAUNCH

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained launch cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Willing to work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

jobs.description:
The Role:

Scale AI is hiring a highly skilled foundational IT Systems Engineer for our Public Sector IT team to design, build, and operate secure, scalable infrastructure that empowers employees to do their best work. You’ll join a creative, fast-moving, solutions-oriented group that architects and implements automation across identity and access management, endpoint management, and our broader SaaS stack. Leveraging Okta Workflows, GCC High/Azure Gov, and your familiarity with federal frameworks (FedRAMP High, IL6, CMMC), you’ll deliver robust, audit-ready systems that meet stringent compliance requirements. The ideal candidate pairs deep IAM best practices and hands-on SaaS administration with a zero-trust mindset, clear documentation, and a genuine drive to make people happy—while protecting system integrity in a fast-paced, high-security environment.

You will:

- Assist with the administration of our tech stack with platforms such as Okta, GCC High, Opal, Slack, Jamf, Jira, and many more

- Provide escalated assistance to the IT Services and Support team

- Partner with Security/Compliance on audit artifacts (SSP updates, POA&Ms, control mappings to NIST 800-53/171, CMMC 2.0).

- Create and update technology documentation for internal IT teams and Scale employees

- Design and maintain Zero-Trust controls (device posture, network segmentation, Conditional Access) across GCC High/Azure Gov and Okta.

- Build Okta Workflows and lightweight services (webhooks/queues) to automate joiner–mover–leaver events, access reviews, and deprovisioning.

- Own change management for IT systems in regulated environments (CAB records, rollback plans, validation evidence).

Ideally you'd have:

- 5+ years of IT systems, infrastructure, and/or engineering experience

- Experience with integrating with SaaS APIs and SDKs

- Experience with leveraging Okta or similar identity management systems for authentication and provisioning methods such as SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

- Scripting experience with Python, Powershell, and/or bash

- Experience working within SCIFs

- Familiarity with IL6 / FedRAMP High / CMMC 2.0 control families and how they translate to concrete IT configs

Nice to haves:

- IT Security and Compliance focused mindset

- Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code for identity/MDM configs (e.g., Terraform providers for Okta/Jamf/Azure)

- Possession of an active Secret or TS/SCI clearance

The Basics:

Tanium's Product Management team is actively seeking a Director, Product Management to lead Policy and Configuration Management for the Endpoint Management portfolio . This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning the strategy, roadmap, and execution of how Tanium defines, applies, and proves configuration state across the enterprise — giving IT and Security teams a single way to set policy once and enforce it consistently across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints, regardless of whether those endpoints are on-premises, remote, or in the cloud.

The successful candidate will own the product strategy behind Tanium's centralized policy engine: application allow/deny control, full-disk encryption, device and removable media control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template (Group Policy-style) policy. This includes the migration tooling that lets customers import existing Group Policy backups and industry hardening standards — such as CIS Build Kits and vendor security baselines — directly into managed policy. You will also shape the next generation of policy types that supersede legacy mechanisms as customers modernize off traditional, on-premises group policy infrastructure.

You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to set vision, drive roadmap, ship capabilities customers trust for compliance and audit, and turn consistent configuration state into measurable risk reduction for customers.

A successful candidate is a strong communicator and influencer who can operate fluently across executive stakeholder conversations, deep technical architecture discussions, and customer-facing storytelling. Must have a successful track record of shipping enterprise configuration management, compliance, or policy products at scale.

What you'll do

- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Tanium's endpoint policy and configuration management capabilities, end to end from ideation to launch.

- Drive the roadmap for Windows policy and configuration management — application control (allow/deny rules), full-disk encryption, device and removable storage control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template policy — ensuring parity with and differentiation from traditional Group Policy infrastructure.

- Expand Linux configuration management capabilities (e.g., host firewall management and hardening controls), building out coverage on top of an established Windows foundation.

- Own the strategy for legacy migration and baseline import tooling — Group Policy backup import and industry hardening standard support (CIS Build Kits, vendor security baselines) that automatically convert a downloaded benchmark file into a ready-to-enforce compliance policy, complete with conflict detection across overlapping settings and automatic content-set mapping — and for next-generation policy types that supersede legacy equivalents as customers modernize.

- Define and evolve policy enforcement state and compliance reporting (applied, partially applied, superseded, not applied) so customers can prove configuration compliance and audit posture at any time.

- Partner with incident response, reporting, and guidance capabilities across the platform to turn security findings into durable preventive policy and to surface actionable configuration drift and remediation guidance to operators.

- Document customer use cases, product requirements, and business justifications for new policy and configuration investments; prioritize ruthlessly based on customer risk reduction, compliance mandates, and platform leverage.

- Partner with Product Marketing and Sales to develop go-to-market motions, enablement, and messaging ; support launches, analyst engagements, and customer briefings.

- Cultivate strategic customer relationships to validate direction, surface gaps, and turn lighthouse deployments into reference architectures.

- Establish and track KPIs — policy adoption, time-to-compliance, configuration drift and remediation rates, and platform pull-through — and use them to drive continuous improvement.

- Leverage emerging trends in agentic AI and autonomous IT to shape the roadmap for self-healing, continuously enforced endpoint configuration.

Requirements

Education

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

- Masters in Computer Science or MBA preferred.

Experience

- 8+ years of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least 5 years in product management supporting a SaaS or enterprise platform.

- Required: hands-on experience with Windows policy and configuration management — Group Policy, ADMX administrative templates, security baselines, full-disk encryption, application control, or comparable endpoint configuration tooling.

- Strong bonus: in-depth experience with Linux configuration management — configuration/hardening frameworks, host firewall management, or compliance baselines for Linux systems.

- Demonstrated success owning and shipping policy, compliance, or configuration management products at enterprise scale.

- Deep familiarity with endpoint management and IT operations — including the customer workflows that span IT and Security teams.

- Strong fluency with compliance frameworks and industry baselines (e.g., CIS benchmarks, vendor security baselines) and how they translate into enforceable policy.

- Experience working with executive stakeholders to align on vision, secure investment, and unblock execution.

- Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, marketing, and sales without direct authority.

Other

- Align with the Tanium values: we win as a team, we do the right thing, and we are unstoppable .

- Intuition to identify high-leverage configuration and compliance gaps that align with Tanium's platform and present opportunities for rapid growth.

- Willingness to take on firmly-entrenched, legacy configuration management incumbents with creative approaches to technology and a tenacious pursuit to build and grow a product's customer base.

- Ability to establish and nurture strong customer champions who can serve as advocates and an informal advisory board.

- Strong written communication, verbal communication, and executive presentation skills.

- Adept at understanding and navigating complex organizations in order to inspire and influence internal and external stakeholders.

- Grit; ability to deal with and overcome challenges, and to thrive in ambiguity.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What you’ll get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $214,000 to $328,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com . For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - https://www.eeoc.gov/poster .

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Secure Devices is responsible for ensuring that every client endpoint at Stripe adheres to our rigorous security standards. Our services play a crucial role in detecting and preventing data loss, restricting software execution to only approved software, and providing attestation capabilities to securely manage device identities. We operate both on-device and backend services across multiple platform types. Our users-first approach ensures that we’re empowering Stripes to be as productive as possible while protecting user data.

What you’ll do

As a software engineer on Secure Devices, you will work at the intersection of software development, security, and client platform engineering. You will work with teams across Security, Infrastructure and Corporate Engineering to drive strategic projects to better secure Stripe endpoints, build infrastructure for supporting new platforms, and operate services critical to securing over 10,000 Stripe devices.

Responsibilities

- Contribute to the secure design and implementation of Stripe’s mobile expansion initiative

- Act as the subject matter expert on iOS security by advising partner teams on iOS security best practices and secure-by-design architectures

- Design, build and maintain Stripe’s endpoint security software. This includes developing telemetry and prevention capabilities via macOS system extensions that run on all Stripe macOS devices

- Collaborate closely with partner teams to define and measure the secure configuration of Stripe’s client platforms (macOS, iOS/Android, ChromeOS)

- Operate high RPS backend services providing critical controls and security configuration to Stripe endpoints

- Drive down usage of unapproved, untrusted software while creating a surprisingly great user experience for onboarding new, approved software

- Manage and improve device attestation flows to ensure Stripe’s device and user identities are kept secure

- Identify opportunities on Stripe client platforms to improve our security posture and resiliency against malware and advanced persistent threats

- Build and maintain a users-first data loss prevention program to protect against accidental and malicious data exfiltration

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

- 4+ years of relevant experience securing iOS and/or macOS platforms

- 4+ years of software engineering experience writing Go, Swift or Objective-C

- Deep expertise securing devices within the Apple ecosystem

- Understanding of the current threat landscape and how to defend Apple devices against modern threats

- High standards for code quality and a constructive attitude to help others raise the bar

- An ability to think creatively and holistically about reducing risk in a complex environment

- The ability to drive clear next steps when encountering ambiguous spaces without clear lines of ownership

- Empathy, strong communication skills and a deep respect for the power of collaboration

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing endpoint detection and response software

- Knowledge of macOS or iOS internals and how they can be used to build security controls and software

- Exposure to data loss prevention strategies

- Ability to develop backend networked applications capable of handling a high number of requests

- General proficiency in securing client devices

- Understanding of topics such as platform hardening, malware detection, and endpoint management through configuration as code

- Understanding of networking protocols across various levels of the stack

- TCP, DNS, SSH, TLS, HTTP

- Linux system administration knowledge

- Additional experience securing alternative platforms including Windows and Android

- Experience working with AWS cloud services

jobs.description:
Overview: SimVentions is 100% employee-owned and proudly ranked among Virginia’s Best Places to Work year after year! We are seeking a Journeyman Cybersecurity Analyst to join our team! This position is seated 100% on site at NSWC Dahlgren, Virginia.

In this role, you’ll craft RMF A&A packages, execute continuous monitoring tasks, and conduct system testing to secure cutting-edge systems. Be part of a team that values innovation, growth, and collaboration.

Travel: Negligible Clearance: An ACTIVE Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility is required for this position. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. US Citizenship is required to obtain a clearance.

Requirements:

Two (2) years program specific security engineering experience working with Navy afloat/tactical combat systems or five (5) years general security engineering experience. Two (2) of the five (5) years of engineering experience on Combat Weapons Systems experience in Aegis, SSDS, Zumwalt, or other Navy afloat tactical combat systems. Certified as IAT Level II or Level III per DoD 8570.01, or successor when performing as an ISSO or ISSE. Understanding of computer security, military system specifications, DoD Cybersecurity policies for both Land Based and afloat/tactical systems, and the ability to communicate clearly and succinctly in written and oral presentations. Responsibilities: Author DoD Cybersecurity Assessment and Authorization artifacts. Author DoD Cybersecurity Assessment and Authorization artifacts. Document a system from a Cybersecurity perspective using Microsoft Office including MS Word, MS Excel and MS Visio and other appropriate tools. Derive, document and/or identify system CONOPS for Mission Assurance Categorization per DoDI 8500.2. Research and recommend logical and physical solutions that prevent, detect and correct the system to be certified and accredited. Apply DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and NSA recommendations. Identify disagreements between as built specifications, security requirements and DoD security policies and recommend approaches to bring the system into compliance. Author and revise system requirements and specifications to meet DoD security policies. Perform vulnerability tests using manual techniques, Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS) and other similar and appropriate IA and security tools. Plan, execute and document risk assessments against known vulnerabilities. Identify and perform security analysis of connectivity relationships between the subject US Naval warfare system and the equipment to which it interfaces, both physically and virtually. Lead and perform as ISSO to be focal point for all security matters related to specific sets of information systems. Define an Information Assurance Vulnerability Management (IAVM) Plan. Plan, execute and document results of security tests. Assist with developing cybersecurity requirements, policy standards, best practices, guidance and procedures for combat systems. Conduct cybersecurity related research, analysis and coordination activities in support of DOD cyber assurance and policy efforts at multiple classification levels. Participate in working groups to develop cybersecurity strategies to meet emerging threats. Assist with analysis of cybersecurity, intelligence and information technology policy gaps for combat systems. Assist with cybersecurity system engineering design, analysis and documentation of combat systems. Assist with developing cybersecurity risk assessment analysis and risk mitigation plans for combat systems. Assist with developing documentation of cybersecurity requirements, gap analysis, threat analysis, system engineering, risk assessment and mitigation for combat systems. Preferred Skills and Experience: CASP, Security +, or CISSP Certifications Education: A bachelors degree in Cybersecurity is preferred.

An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position SummaryThe Senior Platforms Engineer is responsible for the strategic design, deployment, and optimization of complex infrastructure platforms and systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security. This qualified candidate will have proven experience as a technical lead or platform owner for digital workplace or AI initiatives.

This role will maintain ownership throughout the entire lifecycle of AI agents and automation, handling intake, governance, versioning, monitoring, and retirement in production environments. An expected focus of this role is to deliver impactful AI value and usage reports, presenting productivity improvements, risk assessments, and cost optimization metrics to leadership and business stakeholders.

This role leads advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and technical support activities, serving as the primary escalation point for complex issues and collaborating across teams to drive continuous improvement. The Senior Platforms Engineer also oversees resiliency, disaster recovery and backup strategies, develops comprehensive reporting frameworks, and ensures compliance with industry standards and best practices.

The candidate will have designed and implemented secure, enterprise-grade low-code applications for regulated and sensitive data, ensuring compliance and robust protection measures.

Additionally, this position fosters a culture of knowledge sharing by mentoring junior engineers, organizing training sessions, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to enhance documentation and information sharing.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.

jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We've surpassed $400M in ARR and we're continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we're building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world's most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering - Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They'll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship - from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we're using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups.
