Description

About the Role

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Channel to help drive NinjaOne’s expansion into the enterprise market. This is a builder role—your chance to shape how we engage complex accounts, scale technical wins, and define what great looks like in enterprise pre-sales. You’ll own the full technical sales cycle—from discovery and architecture through proof-of-concept and implementation—while partnering closely with AEs to influence deal strategy and deliver real-world impact. You won’t just run demos—you’ll build the playbooks, tools, and repeatable processes that help us scale. If you’ve done this before in B2B SaaS, thrive in high-stakes environments, and want your work to directly shape the next chapter of NinjaOne’s growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - *IL, KS, & TX.

Travel Requirements - ~50%, including strategic customer meetings, industry events, and team collaboration

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the full pre-sales technical experience for Enterprise Partners, Channel, MSPs & Customers. This will include product demonstrations, architecture design, and key customer engagements to drive deal success. Represent NinjaOne at enterprise-facing industry events, conferences, and customer forums.Support the review and alignment of technical content within RFPs and RFIs without owning full proposal management.Partner with Training and Customer Success teams to accelerate time-to-value and ensure long-term adoption success.Serve as a strategic voice between Sales and Product—surfacing feedback, identifying feature gaps, and influencing roadmap direction.Build and maintain reusable technical assets including lab environments, demo flows, battlecards, and scripts to support a scalable AE-to-SE model.Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive growth and align technical value to business goals.Help shape the future of the Enterprise SE function as a founding member of the team, contributing to playbooks, processes, and cross-functional alignment.Other duties as assigned.

Technical Requirements

Proficiency in Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting). Familiarity with Linux/macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting. Strong understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and endpoint protections. Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms and endpoint lifecycle management. Scripting experience in PowerShell, JavaScript, &/or VBScript is strongly preferred. Comfortable navigating complex IT ecosystems and integrating with existing infrastructure. Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Highspot, or equivalent systems is required.

About You

5+ years in a pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role supporting enterprise B2B SaaS customers.Brings deep domain knowledge in enterprise IT operations, RMM, endpoint management, and ITSM-adjacent platforms.Evolved from a technical background (e.g., TAM, support, systems engineer), with practical insight into IT operations at scale.Strong communicator with executive presence—able to tailor messaging for admins, architects, and senior business stakeholders.Understands how IT teams evaluate, implement, and scale solutions—along with insight into the limitations of legacy platforms and the shift toward unified, modern alternatives.Known for high emotional intelligence, technical credibility, and a customer-first mindset.Operates well in ambiguity and brings a builder’s mentality to scaling people, processes, and tools.Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required. Technical certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+, cloud architecture) are a plus.

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Who we are:
Farm Credit Bank of Texas is a $42.2 billion wholesale bank that has been financing agriculture and rural America for over 100 years. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we provide funding and services to rural lending associations in five states, and we are active in the nation's capital markets.
While you may not be familiar with our name, Farm Credit Bank of Texas plays a critical role in supporting the businesses that make it possible for America to maintain access to an affordable and safe food supply, an industry which is one of the most innovative and evolving of our time. And while you help us deliver on our mission, we deliver on our commitment to you as a valued employee by providing competitive compensation, generous health and wellness benefits packages and an attractive workplace located along the bluffs of the Colorado River just minutes west of downtown Austin.
We seek out top talent in their fields, whether it be technology, finance, accounting, credit, human resources, or other administrative functions, and welcome you to join us in our mission to feed the world.
Position Description:
The End-User Computing Senior Engineer is responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, support, and continuous improvement of the Bank's End-User Computing (EUC) environment. This role serves as a senior technical resource for enterprise desktop technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure, endpoint management platforms, mobile device management, and related end-user services.
Working as part of the Information Technology team, the End-User Computing Senior Engineer partners closely with Customer Support, Infrastructure Services, Information Security, and other technology teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable end-user computing solutions. The role provides advanced engineering expertise, resolves complex infrastructure issues, develops automation solutions, and contributes to the strategic direction of the Bank's workplace technology environment.
The position focuses on designing, optimizing, and maintaining modern end-user computing platforms that support business operations while maintaining high standards of security, performance, and user experience. The Senior Engineer leverages deep technical knowledge, industry best practices, and emerging technologies to enhance service delivery, streamline operational processes, and support the Bank's long-term technology objectives.
Operating with a high degree of independence and technical leadership, the End-User Computing Senior Engineer influences technology decisions, mentors team members, identifies opportunities for improvement, and helps drive the roadmap for end-user technology solutions throughout the organization.
Day-to-Day Duties and Responsibilities:
* Monitor and maintain the health, performance, and availability of servers and infrastructure supporting enterprise EUC services.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and preventative maintenance for desktop, endpoint, and virtual desktop technologies.
* Provide third-tier technical support and technical leadership for Customer Support and other EUC team members.
* Design and implement solutions that strengthen system reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Enhance system security through endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, and security-focused engineering practices.
* Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, standards, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures.
* Diagnose complex infrastructure issues and design effective technical solutions to address business and operational needs.
* Design, build, and maintain advanced automation solutions that reduce manual effort and improve service delivery.
* Participate in the planning, architecture, design, implementation, and lifecycle management of EUC technologies and services.
* Research emerging technologies, industry trends, and vendor solutions to support innovation and long-term roadmap development.
* Evaluate, test, and recommend new products, tools, and processes that improve end-user computing capabilities and reliability.
* Track work requests, operational activities, incidents, projects, and service improvements through the Bank's IT service management processes.
* Communicate infrastructure updates, maintenance activities, technology changes, and project status to management, support teams, and end users as appropriate.
* Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure Services, and application teams to support strategic technology initiatives, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Provide technical mentoring, knowledge sharing, and guidance to engineers, administrators, and support staff across the IT organization.
What You Bring to the Team:
Our ideal candidate has extensive experience designing, supporting, and optimizing enterprise end-user computing environments and enjoys solving complex technical challenges while helping shape the future of workplace technology.
This role requires a combination of engineering expertise, infrastructure architecture, automation development, systems administration, and technical leadership, including:
* Associate's degree, technical school certification, or equivalent technical experience.
* Professional certifications in Microsoft, Omnissa, VMware, or related technologies.
* Four (4) to seven (7) years of experience as a Systems Administrator, Systems Engineer, End-User Computing Engineer, or similar technology role.
* Alternatively, one applicable certification plus three (3) additional years of relevant experience.
* Experience administering enterprise Windows environments, desktop infrastructure, and endpoint management platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Experience supporting enterprise endpoint technologies, desktop operating systems, mobile devices, and end-user productivity platforms.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy, accountability, and customer service.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while successfully collaborating with cross-functional technology teams.
* Demonstrated technical leadership skills, including mentoring, knowledge sharing, and influencing technology decisions.
* Commitment to operational excellence, continuous improvement, and delivering secure, reliable technology solutions.
Preferred:
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Expert-level knowledge in two or more End-User Computing disciplines, including virtual desktop infrastructure, Windows management, endpoint management, or mobile device management.
* Advanced PowerShell scripting experience and developing enterprise automation solutions.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices for EUC platforms.
* Experience designing and supporting high availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows security practices, including patching, hardening, vulnerability management, and anti-malware controls.
* Experience supporting Windows 11, Microsoft 365 applications, and modern workplace technologies in enterprise environments.
* Experience supporting Windows Autopilot, device provisioning, and modern desktop deployment methodologies.
* Experience supporting cloud computing platforms, including Microsoft Azure and Azure Virtual Desktop environments.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) monitoring solutions such as ControlUp.
* Experience supporting collaboration and conferencing technologies, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco Webex, and related platforms.
* Experience working within regulated financial services, banking, or highly controlled technology environments.
Why Farm Credit Bank of Texas:
In addition to a competitive salary, we offer comprehensive, affordable, and competitive benefit options that are focused on health and wellness, financial security, and achieving a work-life balance:
* Flexible health-and-wellness benefits, including medical insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental insurance, vision care, flexible spending accounts, and more.
* 401(k) plan that includes immediate vesting of a generous employer match and additional employer contribution.
* Long-term disability and life insurance.
* Vacation leave, sick leave, and paid holidays.
* Fertility benefit and parental leave plan.
* Up to two days per year to volunteer in local community organizations, services, or events.
* Ongoing professional-development opportunities.
* Generous tuition-reimbursement program.
* Physical fitness incentive plan.
* Employer matching gifts program.
Important note: We care about your hiring process and take it seriously. A real person will review your applications, meaning response timelines may vary. The interviewing process at Farm Credit Bank of Texas may include phone calls and emails, on-site interviews, and requests for portfolios or demonstrations of work. We can't personally follow up with each applicant, and we will do our best to create a professional, respectful, and thorough process for candidates with whom we identify as a potential fit.

jobs.description:
Company Information

At Bit By Bit, we’ve been helping organizations thrive since 1987. Originally founded as a database application development and networking company, we’ve grown into a full-service IT firm and a recognized leader in delivering reliable, cost-effective managed IT services across the Tri-State area.

Our team specializes in building and managing solutions that solve critical business challenges. With a unique blend of business technology expertise, certified technicians, and proven processes, we provide our clients with tailored IT solutions that improve productivity, strengthen security, streamline communications, and reduce costs. Beyond technology, our culture is rooted in humility and curiosity, and our vision is simple: to help untangle people and process challenges so businesses can move forward with confidence.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Windows Systems Engineer / Administrator to support and administer enterprise Microsoft infrastructure across Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure, and virtualized environments.

This is a senior technical role responsible for the ongoing administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, lifecycle management, and improvement of critical server and cloud infrastructure. The successful candidate will have extensive hands-on experience managing Microsoft environments and will be comfortable working independently on complex technical issues while collaborating with other engineers, administrators, and stakeholders.

The role also requires the ability to provide technical guidance and coordinate the work of a small team of highly technical engineers and administrators when needed.

Requirements

Duties and Responsibilities

Windows Server Administration

Administer, maintain, and support Windows Server environments, including Windows Server 2012 R2, 2016, 2019, 2022, and 2025. Manage the full Windows Server operating system lifecycle, including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and decommissioning. Support both physical and virtual Windows Server environments. Monitor server health, performance, capacity, and availability and proactively address infrastructure issues. Troubleshoot complex Windows Server incidents and identify appropriate corrective and preventative actions. Plan and execute server upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and infrastructure changes.

Active Directory & Core Microsoft Infrastructure

Administer and support enterprise Active Directory environments, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory). Manage users, groups, permissions, organizational units, authentication, and other Active Directory services. Administer and troubleshoot Group Policy (GPO), DNS, DHCP, Windows File Systems, and Print Servers. Support hybrid identity environments and integration between on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft cloud services. Troubleshoot authentication, access, replication, policy, and other Active Directory-related issues.

Microsoft 365 & Exchange

Administer and support Microsoft 365 environments. Manage Microsoft Exchange and Exchange Online administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Support Microsoft 365 users, licensing, permissions, mailboxes, groups, and related services. Troubleshoot complex Microsoft 365 and Exchange issues and coordinate resolution of service-impacting incidents. Support Microsoft 365 and Exchange migrations, upgrades, and configuration changes as required.

Microsoft Azure

Administer and support Microsoft Azure environments. Manage Azure-based infrastructure and services related to Windows Server and Microsoft enterprise environments. Support identity, access, security, configuration, and integration between Azure and on-premises systems. Troubleshoot Azure infrastructure and connectivity issues.

Virtualization

Administer Windows Server nodes within virtualized environments. Manage and support Microsoft Hyper-V environments. Support VMware environments as required. Assist with or lead migrations from VMware to Microsoft Hyper-V where applicable. Troubleshoot virtual machine, host, storage, resource, and performance-related issues.

Additional Systems Administration

Configure, administer, and troubleshoot Microsoft IIS. Configure and administer SFTP environments and services. Support Windows file systems, permissions, storage, and related infrastructure. Participate in infrastructure upgrades, migrations, deployments, and technical projects. Apply security, patching, and system-management standards across supported infrastructure.

Technical Leadership & Service Delivery

Provide senior-level technical support and guidance for complex infrastructure issues. Assist and mentor engineers and administrators in troubleshooting and systems administration. Coordinate technical activities across a small team when required. Prioritize competing incidents, service requests, maintenance activities, and project requirements. Work collaboratively with technical teams and other stakeholders to resolve infrastructure issues. Maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, procedures, and change records. jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Who we are:
Farm Credit Bank of Texas is a $42.2 billion wholesale bank that has been financing agriculture and rural America for over 100 years. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we provide funding and services to rural lending associations in five states, and we are active in the nation's capital markets.
While you may not be familiar with our name, Farm Credit Bank of Texas plays a critical role in supporting the businesses that make it possible for America to maintain access to an affordable and safe food supply, an industry which is one of the most innovative and evolving of our time. And while you help us deliver on our mission, we deliver on our commitment to you as a valued employee by providing competitive compensation, generous health and wellness benefits packages and an attractive workplace located along the bluffs of the Colorado River just minutes west of downtown Austin.
We seek out top talent in their fields, whether it be technology, finance, accounting, credit, human resources, or other administrative functions, and welcome you to join us in our mission to feed the world.
Position Description:
The End-User Computing Engineer is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and securing the Bank's End-User Computing (EUC) environment. This role serves as a technical resource for the implementation, management, optimization, and troubleshooting of enterprise desktop technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure, endpoint management platforms, and related end-user services.
Working as part of the Information Technology team, the End-User Computing Engineer collaborates closely with Customer Support, Infrastructure Services, Information Security, and other technology teams to maintain reliable, secure, and efficient EUC services. The role provides advanced technical expertise, third-tier support, and engineering solutions that improve system performance, strengthen security, and enhance the overall user experience.
The position focuses on ensuring the availability, scalability, and security of the Bank's endpoint computing environment through proactive administration, automation, and continuous improvement. The End-User Computing Engineer leverages technical expertise to support modern workplace technologies, streamline operations, and deliver solutions that align with the Bank's business objectives and technology strategy.
Operating with a high degree of ownership and accountability, the End-User Computing Engineer identifies improvement opportunities, resolves complex technical issues, implements technology enhancements, and helps ensure that employees have secure and reliable access to the systems and tools they need to perform their work effectively.
Day-to-Day Duties and Responsibilities:
* Monitor and maintain enterprise EUC services to ensure acceptable levels of performance, reliability, and availability.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting, problem resolution, and preventative maintenance for desktop, endpoint, and virtual desktop technologies.
* Provide third-tier technical support and technical guidance to Customer Support and other IT teams.
* Administer and support desktop operating systems, endpoint management platforms, mobile devices, and related technologies.
* Enhance system security through endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, and security-focused engineering practices.
* Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, standards, procedures, and operational support materials.
* Create and maintain automation solutions and scripts that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and optimize operational processes.
* Manage assigned EUC systems and services, ensuring consistent performance, support, maintenance, and lifecycle management.
* Track work requests, operational activities, incidents, and project tasks through the Bank's IT service management processes.
* Communicate infrastructure updates, maintenance activities, and technology changes to management, support teams, and end users as appropriate.
* Support operating system and application deployment, patching, packaging, and update management activities.
* Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure Services, and application teams to support technology initiatives, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Participate in the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new technologies that improve the employee computing experience and support the Bank's strategic objectives.
What You Bring to the Team:
Our ideal candidate has experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments and enjoys working in a collaborative, customer-focused technology organization dedicated to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
This role requires a combination of endpoint engineering, systems administration, automation, troubleshooting, and customer service expertise, including:
* Associate's degree, technical school certification, or equivalent technical experience.
* Professional certifications in Microsoft, Omnissa, VMware, or related technologies preferred.
* Three (3) or more years of experience as a Systems Administrator, Systems Engineer, End-User Computing Engineer, or similar technology role.
* Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and experience may be considered.
* Experience administering enterprise Windows environments, desktop platforms, and endpoint management solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues.
* Experience supporting desktop operating systems, mobile devices, endpoint security, and end-user productivity tools.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of service, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively collaborating across cross-functional technology teams.
* Commitment to operational excellence, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality technical support and engineering solutions.
Preferred:
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting, automation, and systems management tools.
* Experience supporting virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), including Omnissa Horizon, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop environments.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and automated platform management.
* Experience with endpoint security technologies, vulnerability management, and remediation programs.
* Experience supporting Windows 11, Microsoft 365 applications, and modern workplace technologies.
* Experience with Windows Autopilot, device provisioning, and modern desktop deployment methodologies.
* Experience administering cloud-based computing environments, including Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) monitoring solutions such as ControlUp.
* Experience supporting collaboration and conferencing technologies including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco Webex, and related platforms.
* Experience working within regulated financial services, banking, or highly controlled technology environments.
Why Farm Credit Bank of Texas:
In addition to a competitive salary, we offer comprehensive, affordable, and competitive benefit options that are focused on health and wellness, financial security, and achieving a work-life balance:
* Flexible health-and-wellness benefits, including medical insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental insurance, vision care, flexible spending accounts, and more.
* 401(k) plan that includes immediate vesting of a generous employer match and additional employer contribution.
* Long-term disability and life insurance.
* Vacation leave, sick leave, and paid holidays.
* Fertility benefit and parental leave plan.
* Up to two days per year to volunteer in local community organizations, services, or events.
* Ongoing professional-development opportunities.
* Generous tuition-reimbursement program.
* Physical fitness incentive plan.
* Employer matching gifts program.
Important note: We care about your hiring process and take it seriously. A real person will review your applications, meaning response timelines may vary. The interviewing process at Farm Credit Bank of Texas may include phone calls and emails, on-site interviews, and requests for portfolios or demonstrations of work. We can't personally follow up with each applicant, and we will do our best to create a professional, respectful, and thorough process for candidates with whom we identify as a potential fit.

jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

**Content & Business Products (CBP) Overview:**

The Content & Business Products (CBP) teams are fundamental to Netflix's mission to entertain the world. This organization is responsible for building the products and services that optimize and automate the entire content creation lifecycle, from initial concept and financial planning to global launch and promotion.

CBP is the engine behind "pitch to play," enabling our teams to create, manage, and distribute content at scale. In addition, we build and maintain critical enterprise products that ensure efficient operations across key internal departments, including Finance, Talent, and Customer Support.

**The Team - Enterprise Engineering**

By deploying world-class solutions across business functions and seamlessly integrating critical data streams, we empower our business units to scale efficiently, mitigate risks, and enhance decision-making to deliver a thrilling member experience. Our guiding principle is to champion a "Connected Enterprise"—where integrated data and workflows replace isolated point solutions.

We are seeking a dynamic Technical Program Manager with high agency and a strong sense of ownership to lead high-impact, cross-functional programs. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and Data Science teams, as well as stakeholders across Finance, Talent, Legal, and Customer Support. Partnering with fellow TPMs and senior leadership, you will execute, track, and deliver strategic initiatives that drive significant business value.

**Responsibilities**

- Take full ownership of programs from inception to delivery, proactively driving progress with a high agency mindset.
- Lead multiple cross-functional programs, in collaboration with product, engineering, design, and data science, that deliver technical solutions.
- Drive engagement with cross-functional partners, work to decompose requirements into technical execution plans with measurable milestones, effectively optimize scope and schedule, manage cross-functional dependencies, and proactively identify and manage risks.
- Craft clear, concise communication regarding progress toward goals, reporting status and insights to stakeholders and executive leadership.
- Provide domain expertise to form technical strategies with engineering partners.
- Scope and lead the execution of Generative AI/ML initiatives, working with engineering and data science partners to identify high-value use cases and productionize new AI platform capabilities.
- Apply strong technical, organizational, and communication skills to devise sound technical approaches to abstract goals.
- Identify the systems involved to build new solutions, align roadmaps, and weigh relative priorities.
- Build strong relationships and rally the team with high emotional intelligence and exceptional listening skills.
- Operate independently, challenge the status quo, and always play for the larger team.

**Requirements**

- 7+ years of technical program management experience
- Proven experience driving large-scale software projects, managing the definition of technical strategies, and building long-term scalable solutions
- Highly skilled, experienced, and enjoys orchestrating multiple programs with many moving parts and creating partnerships with cross-functional teams
- Ability to identify solution gaps, debate technical approaches, and influence product vs. technology tradeoffs.
- Deep understanding and point of view on the application of agentic capabilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate business impact and technical constraints tailored to the audience
- As comfortable speaking technically as non-technically and able to bridge between the two.
- Detail-oriented, can identify what’s missing in planning and execution of software development, testing, and launch.
- Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $290,000.00 - $460,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. jobs.description:
The IT Systems Engineering team builds the systems and processes that keep Asana running: endpoint management, identity, and the enterprise applications every Asana employee uses every day. As Manager of IT Applications and Client Platform Engineering, you’ll lead four engineers: two on client platform, two on applications. You report directly to the Head of IT Systems Engineering. This is a player/coach role: you set direction, run planning, and step in on escalations and architecture decisions while your engineers own most of the day-to-day. Your primary depth is in endpoint engineering; you have enough SaaS administration background to lead the apps side without micromanaging it. We’re looking for someone who knows endpoint work deeply and is ready to grow as a manager. Your title history matters less than technical foundation and how you work with people.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you’re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

- Lead and develop your team. Manage and mentor four engineers (two on CPE, two on Apps). Set priorities, clear blockers, and help each person grow.

- Own the client platform program. Set strategy and lead execution for Asana’s endpoint fleet: macOS, Windows, and mobile. This means MDM infrastructure, zero-touch deployment, software catalog, and OS lifecycle. We’re primarily an Apple shop with a growing Windows footprint.

- Strengthen endpoint security. Work with the Corporate Security team to harden our endpoint posture, respond to incidents, and build initiatives that connect security priorities and endpoints.

- Oversee the applications engineering function. Your Apps engineers manage the SaaS portfolio: Asana, Google Workspace, Slack, Zendesk, DocuSign, 1Password, Slab, Figma, and more. You set direction, stay close enough to catch problems early, and step in when something needs senior judgment.

- Be the technical escalation. When a hard endpoint problem surfaces, an MDM decision needs to be made, or a cross-team initiative needs senior ownership, that’s you.

- Push automation and efficiency. Spot opportunities to reduce manual work through scripting, APIs, and workflow tooling. Build the expectation that if something is repetitive, the team automates it.

- Work across the organization. Partner with Corporate Security, HR, Legal, and other business teams to understand what they need, communicate what IT is building, and ship solutions that work.

- Document and share knowledge. Make sure your team documents clearly and hands off processes that others can follow.

About you

- Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

- Experience managing client endpoint infrastructure: macOS and Windows required, mobile (iOS/Android) a strong plus.

- Hands-on with MDM platforms like Jamf, Intune, BigFix, or AirWatch; familiar with zero-touch deployment methods.

- Comfortable with identity platforms like Okta and how they connect to endpoint management.

- Can write scripts in Bash or PowerShell; familiar with APIs and orchestration tools like Workato.

- Enough SaaS administration experience — Google Workspace, Slack, and similar — to lead a team that owns it.

- Some management experience. This is a good role for a senior engineer who has led projects or a small team and is ready for the next step. We care more about how you think technically and how you work with people than what your title has been.

- You communicate clearly, prioritize in writing, and know when to solve a problem yourself and when to hand it off.

At Asana, we’re committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you’re interested in this role and don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we’re committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $194,000 - $220,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you’re interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

- Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits

- Career coaching & support

- Inclusive family building benefits

- Long-term savings or retirement plans

- In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you’re interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. L’architecte dirige le comité cloud, qui fait office d’instance d’approbation pour l’adoption et le déploiement de nouveaux services cloud au sein du groupe.

Principales responsabilités

Stratégie et architecture cloud

At Philip Morris International (PMI), we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future.

Our success depends on people who are committed to our purpose and have an appetite for progress.

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Information Management, or Information Technology.5+ years of experience as an MDM Engineer with end to end design and development and hands on experience with MDM Tools (Profisee, SAP MDG, informatica, Reltio etc.) and Snowflake, Azure SQL database.Knowledge of standard data models within master data domains – Product, Customer, Finance, Reference Data, etc.Advanced SQL programming and building ETL/ELT processes using cloud platforms like Azure Data Factory or Matillion.Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Information Management, or Information Technology.Legally authorized to work in the U.S.Commutable distance to Tampa, Florida.

Since 2008, PMI has invested $12.5 billion globally to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke with the goal of transitioning legal-age consumers who smoke to better alternatives. In 2022, PMI acquired Swedish Match – a leader in oral nicotine delivery – creating a global smoke-free champion led by the IQOS and ZYN brands. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has authorized versions of PMI’s IQOS electronically heated tobacco devices and Swedish Match’s General snus as Modified Risk Tobacco Products and renewal applications for these products are presently pending before the FDA. WHAT IS BOX?Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.
By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It ‘ s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more.

Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHAT YOU’LL DOThe Senior IT Platform & Identity Engineer will join a global team comprised of the most talented IT professionals in the industry. Box IT is looking for an exceptional candidate to support our IT Platform & Identity team across client endpoint management systems and various SaaS solutions, while also supporting our IAM ecosystem. As an IT Platform & Identity Engineer, you will work on a variety of different systems and software to maintain our corporate endpoint and mobile device ecosystem, support our Identity and Access Management strategy (IAMs), and build new integrations across various cloud services that support day-to-day operations for IT and Security. To succeed in this fast-paced, challenging position you will need to be a highly motivated problem solver, focused on frictionless outcomes in support of the best possible end user experience, and deeply passionate about all things IT.

Develop and maintain documentation for systems and architectural standards.

Administer client platform management tools and frameworks. We use Kandji, Intune, Active Directory Entra & ADE, and continuously explore other solutions.

Manage and administer a mixed platform environment (macOS, iOS, Android & Windows) using the above client system management tools.

Develop and manage client administration tools/processes.

Streamline, implement, and iterate on current provisioning solutions.

Design and scale monitoring and alerting tools, in collaboration with other teams across IT.

Write modular, maintainable tooling in traditional and low-code systems such as Powershell, Python, Shell (zsh) and Okta Workflows, with a strong focus on automation to reduce repeated work and auto-remediation with low to no end-user involvement.

Regularly partner with the security team to ensure Box is a continued leader in the intelligent content management space.

Provide Tier III support and troubleshooting for complex issues escalated from the IT Support team.

Mentor more junior team members and provide direction and guidance when appropriate.

Proven experience and track record troubleshooting complex macOS and Windows problems in an enterprise environment with a strong emphasis on security.

Knowledge of DHCP, DNS, Active Directory (and/or Entra ID), AD Group Policy.

Must have strong experience in IAM platforms such as Okta, Duo, PingFed, OneLogin, Entra ID, etc.

Experience with one or more programming languages relevant to scripting, automation, and interacting with APIs (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc).

Experience implementing and supporting IT applications and client platforms “at scale”.

Strong ability to interact with and understand complex technical requirements across all levels of the organization.

Working knowledge of essential security concepts.

Strong ability to analyze and solve complex business problems.

Strong ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally, including working with a geographically distributed team.

Strong organizational, planning, documentation skills & excellent attention to detail.

Box is a global enterprise with offices worldwide. Must be willing to occasionally adjust schedule to meet/work with team members in alternative timezones.

Overview
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment. Join our Technology Team as a Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer located in various offices. We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team. This role can be based in various offices, on a hybrid basis. This role reports to the Enterprise Monitoring and Systems Management Supervisor.
Position Summary
The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining enterprise-level systems, applications, services, and cloud platforms. This role proactively and reactively defends against security threats, troubleshoots and resolves complex technical issues, investigates and mitigates security incidents, and ensures the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise platforms. The engineer also supports ongoing modernization initiatives and collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver stable and scalable technology services. This role requires a strategic thinker with deep hands-on technical expertise in IT infrastructure, security operations, automation, and cloud security. This role also requires individuals who are trustworthy, reliable, and uphold strict ethical standards in all professional dealings. Flexibility to work non-standard hours and participate in on-call rotation is required.

Designs, implements, and optimizes enterprise IT infrastructure services across on-premises and cloud environments, including core identity, platform, and systems management services
Oversees implementation, management, and optimization of enterprise security and monitoring tools and systems (e.g. antivirus, EDR, ITDR, and FIM platforms)
Oversees implementation, manages, and enhances privileged access management (PAM) system
Monitors, detects, and responds to security threats, leading incident response efforts, from detection to resolution and post-incident reviews
Conducts regular audits and assessments of server security and application, system, and data access controls, vulnerability management, and implements security best practices and recommendations, to ensure compliance with security policies and standards, and to protect the firm's data and assets
Plans and implements system and application security updates and patches to remediate vulnerabilities in collaboration with IT, compliance, and vulnerability management teams
Designs, implements, and manages security controls to protect against unauthorized access, data loss, and other security threats against the firm’s on-prem infrastructure and cloud-based platforms
Monitors system performance, troubleshoots complex issues, and ensures high availability of servers, appliances, and applications

Leverages APIs for integration, automation, and enhancement of monitoring and management across systems and tools

Maintains up-to-date knowledge of emerging trends and best practices in infrastructure modernization, security, monitoring, cloud platforms, and AI model infrastructure security

Strong working knowledge of virtualization and Microsoft 365

Strong background in security operations, endpoint security, and incident response
Strong knowledge of public key infrastructure (PKI) and cryptography
Proven expertise in Active Directory Domain Services and Entra ID management
Advanced understanding of authentication and authorization flows
Deep understanding of identity and access management and role-based access control concepts
Good working knowledge of and experience troubleshooting Microsoft technologies, such as SQL, IIS, and SharePoint
Strong working knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN
Strong knowledge of and experience with single sign-on protocols (SAML, OIDC)
Strong knowledge of multifactor authentication management
Good working knowledge of SQL and SSRS and ability to write and optimize queries and reports

Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Graph PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API
Solid understanding and experience with API programming (REST, JSON, authentication mechanisms) and security

jobs.description:
ACS Desktop Workstations Windows System Engineer
Description -
The Systems Engineer for ACS Desktop Workstations is responsible for defining, integrating, and validating the end‑to‑end Windows software solution for new workstation platforms. This role owns system-level design and integration across Windows OS, drivers, firmware, HP applications, recovery solutions, and PAN/PS-delivered components.

This role represents the Windows software stack within the platform team, ensuring a cohesive, high-quality workstation experience across the NPI and refresh lifecycles.

Key Responsibilities:
Windows NPI Program Ownership

Drive system architecture, integration, and interface alignment across platform components
Ensure seamless integration of Windows OS, drivers, HP applications, imaging, and recovery solutions
Lead system-level validation, debug, and root cause analysis to ensure quality and performance
Partner with engineering, ODMs, and factory teams to deliver a robust, production-ready system
Define and validate release readiness criteria from a full system perspective

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

Serve as the Windows SEPM representative on the system team and R&D Program Alignment Team, coordinating with:

Program management
OS Engineering (Windows)
BIOS/FW teams
Validation and Quality
Factory, PIN, and Supply Chain
ODM program management and engineering team
Lead technical alignment and decision‑making across stakeholders to resolve integration gaps and risks.

Issue Management & Escalation

Own Windows-related issue resolution/triage, prioritization, tracking, and closure for NPI.
Host and drive tiger teams for critical, blocking, aging, or bounce issues.
Perform risk assessment and elevate program-level concerns to management with clear mitigation plans.

Release & RTM Execution

Ensure completion of Windows validation and readiness for:

Image RTM/Release
Web packages and Windows Update readiness
Factory and recovery media enablement

Drive Windows RTM communications and ensure downstream alignment across HP.com, factory, and service channels.

ODM & Factory Enablement

Writes and executes complete testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portion of application
Coordinate closely with ODM SEPMs to ensure Windows deliverables meet HP quality and schedule targets.

Support factory ramp, production line issues, and early-life field escalations related to Windows software.
Ensure smooth transition from NPI to sustaining ownership post-RTM.

Status, Communication & Reporting

Consolidate and communicate Windows program status to R&D program team and system leadership and functional stakeholders.
Maintain clear visibility of risks, dependencies, and recovery plans.
Support phase exit readiness reviews and executive updates.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
5+ years in technical program management, systems engineering, or software program leadership.
Strong understanding of Windows OS integration, drivers, BIOS/FW interaction, and system validation.
Experience working with ODMs and factory partners in NPI environments.
Proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional programs to on-time delivery.

Preferred Qualifications:

Desktop or workstation platform experience.
Familiarity with Windows image build processes including Windows ADK, driver qualification, and factory readiness.
Ability to read, understand, and write simple Windows scripts.
Experience managing RTM, posting drivers for customer use, and sustaining release flows.
Strong risk management, communication, and executive presentation skills.

Success Indicators

On-time Windows RTM aligned with system launch.
Reduced late-stage integration risk and escalations.
Clear ownership and accountability across HP and ODM teams.
Predictable, well-communicated Windows software readiness for NPI platforms.

jobs.description:
About the Company
The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. In the six years since founding, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

About the Role
KoBold’s IT function supports a globally distributed team of ~280 geoscientists, data scientists, and engineers working across North America, Zambia, the DRC, and field exploration sites around the world. As we scale, our IT needs are evolving rapidly—from reactive, break/fix helpdesk support toward proactive, automated IT operations that work seamlessly across geographies, including remote field sites with limited connectivity.

This role includes but is not limited to, endpoint management, software procurement and renewals, identity and access administration, license optimization, vendor management, employee onboarding and offboarding, hardware lifecycle management, and IT training. You’ll lead a team of IT support staff, set technical direction, manage the annual software budget, and be the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks—renewals don’t expire, new hires have everything they need on day one, and the fleet is healthy and compliant.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll spend meaningful time building and configuring systems yourself—writing Okta provisioning workflows, managing Jamf and Intune policies in Terraform, scripting automation for repetitive work—while also coaching and mentoring your direct reports, setting priorities, and raising the bar for what IT operations looks like at a fast-moving exploration technology company.

Responsibilities
Endpoint Management & Fleet Operations

Help build IT roadmap, setting technical direction for endpoint management, fleet automation, and IT operations across all KoBold offices and field sites in 10+ countries
Design and implement zero-touch provisioning and automated reimaging workflows for macOS (Jamf) and Windows (Intune) endpoints
Build endpoint monitoring, alerting, and fleet health dashboards to shift IT from reactive to proactive support
Drive device lifecycle management including EoL/EoS tracking, hardware refresh planning, and inventory management across Jamf, Intune, CrowdStrike, and related tooling
Create self-service application deployment and access workflows to reduce helpdesk volume and empower employees
Apply DevOps principles to IT operations: configuration-as-code (e.g. managing Intune policies via Terraform), infrastructure automation, version-controlled policies, and repeatable processes
Own internet reliability and network performance at all global remote KoBold sites

Software Procurement, Licensing & Vendor Management

Manage the full software procurement lifecycle: new purchases, renewals, expansions, and cancellations, ensuring user access is never disrupted by lapsed licenses or last-minute renewals
Own and drive execution of the annual software budget, including process improvements year-over-year and proactive renewal pipeline visibility for legal and finance
Optimize license utilization across the SaaS portfolio—track usage, right-size seat counts, consolidate redundant tools, and negotiate pricing with vendors
Coordinate with legal on contract review, working within the existing procurement process to move quickly on low-risk purchases while ensuring appropriate review for larger spend
Onboard new SaaS applications with proper Okta integration (SSO, SCIM) before launch, and manage decommissioning of deprecated tools

Identity, Access & Employee Lifecycle

Own Okta administration including SSO integrations, SCIM provisioning, group management, access request workflows, and lifecycle automation
Manage Google Workspace administration, including license management, security settings, and break-glass super-admin governance
Build automation for minimal-touch employee onboarding and offboarding—ensuring new hires are fully provisioned on day one and departing employees are cleanly deprovisioned
Support AI tooling rollout (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and related tools) across the endpoint fleet, including deployment, configuration, and employee training

Team Leadership & Training

Supervise and mentor IT support staff, providing technical coaching, priority-setting, performance management, and career development
Develop and maintain IT training programs for new hires and ongoing employee enablement, including documentation, video walkthroughs, and live onboarding sessions
Provide helpdesk backup on high-volume days, modeling the standard of responsiveness and quality you expect from the team

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Learn about mineral exploration by working closely with exploration teams, including time in the field in remote operations
Collaborate with infrastructure engineering and security teams on cross-cutting initiatives including observability, access controls, endpoint security posture, and incident response
Partner across the company to contribute to specification, vendor selection, and change management on new software requests
Partner with finance on budget tracking, invoice approvals, and AFE submissions for software spend
Work with legal to streamline the contract review pipeline, maintain lead times on renewals, and advocate for tiered review processes that match risk to effort
Coordinate digitization efforts across the globe, ensuring consistent standards and tooling for converting physical records to digital archives at field and office sites

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in IT engineering, IT management, or a similar role combining hands-on technical depth with operational ownership
Strong experience with MDM platforms, particularly Jamf (macOS) and Microsoft Intune (Windows), including policy configuration, automated enrollment, compliance enforcement, and ideally infrastructure-as-code approaches (e.g. Terraform)
Experience with identity and access management platforms (Okta strongly preferred), including SSO integration, SCIM provisioning, access request workflows, and lifecycle automation
Experience managing software procurement and renewals: specification and change management, vendor negotiation, license optimization, renewal pipeline management, and budget ownership
Hands-on experience building zero-touch provisioning, automated reimaging, and self-service deployment workflows
Experience with endpoint monitoring and fleet management at scale, including remote/distributed environments
People management or technical lead experience: demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and grow IT staff while maintaining high execution standards
Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar) for building automation and tooling
Intellectually curious; eager to learn about the substance of mineral exploration and exploration technology
Excellent communication and collaboration skills—comfortable working across disciplines with engineers, scientists, legal, finance, and leadership in a remote-first environment
Proven ability to take ownership: you build the roadmap, do the research, implement the solution, write the documentation, and communicate the rollout
Strong prioritization instincts—you can look at a long list of IT initiatives and distinguish what actually matters from nice-to-haves, and you can explain why
Comfort with ambiguity and a dynamic work environment; eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities at a fast-growing company
Experience supporting global teams across multiple time zones is a strong plus
Familiarity with Google Workspace administration, CrowdStrike, Datadog, or similar tooling is a plus

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

This position is full-time, exempt.

The US base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $150,000 - $180,000 USD, plus equity and benefits including 401k matching.

Location: KoBold is a remote-first workplace. We are open to candidates currently residing anywhere in the United States or Canada. CST or EST time zone preferred. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada.

An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Platforms Engineer is responsible for the strategic design, deployment, and optimization of complex infrastructure platforms and systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security. This qualified candidate will have proven experience as a technical lead or platform owner for digital workplace or AI initiatives.

This role will maintain ownership throughout the entire lifecycle of AI agents and automation, handling intake, governance, versioning, monitoring, and retirement in production environments. An expected focus of this role is to deliver impactful AI value and usage reports, presenting productivity improvements, risk assessments, and cost optimization metrics to leadership and business stakeholders.

This role leads advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and technical support activities, serving as the primary escalation point for complex issues and collaborating across teams to drive continuous improvement. The Senior Platforms Engineer also oversees resiliency, disaster recovery and backup strategies, develops comprehensive reporting frameworks, and ensures compliance with industry standards and best practices.

The candidate will have designed and implemented secure, enterprise-grade low-code applications for regulated and sensitive data, ensuring compliance and robust protection measures.

Additionally, this position fosters a culture of knowledge sharing by mentoring junior engineers, organizing training sessions, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to enhance documentation and information sharing.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

Identifies performance bottlenecks, conducts root cause analysis, and proposes and implements solutions to enhance platform & system performance and resource utilization. Establishes performance benchmarks, conducts capacity planning, and collaborates with other teams, including junior engineers and cross functional teams to optimize infrastructure performance and activities.Contributes to the development and improvement of troubleshooting procedures, measures to minimize platform & system downtime, and documentation. Partners with technical support to drive for resolution. Leads and manages platform & system technical support activities and troubleshooting efforts, including handling escalated and complex issues. Performs advanced system tuning and optimization to maximize performance using IT Service Management practices. Collaborates with Systems and Solution Architects, Governance, Regulatory and Compliance as well as other organizational teams to enhance support processes and methodologies.Participates in future platform & system backup planning. Leads the design of disaster/system recovery and testing.Analyzes Power Platform, Copilot Studio, AI agent, and digital workplace platform performance and utilization data to identify trends and patterns. Provides recommendations for optimization, cost efficiency, reliability, and value realization. Prepares executive‑ready reporting and drives corrective actions to continuously improve platform and AI service outcomes.Leads development of advanced troubleshooting procedures and operational runbooks for Power Platform solutions, AI agents, and automations. Serves as the primary escalation point for complex platform, automation, or agent issues. Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve incidents and continuously improve service reliability and operational maturity.Leads the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive knowledge base for platforms & systems, including troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and best practices. Promotes knowledge sharing culture by organizing training sessions, mentoring junior engineers, and encouraging cross-team collaboration.

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience required Five (5) or more years of relevant experience required.Administered and supported Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Agents, Azure Services) in enterprise environments highly preferred.Experience applying automation design patterns, managed error handling, monitoring, and provided operational support for platforms highly preferred.Developed and delivered platform usage, reliability, and adoption reporting for leadership and stakeholders preferred.Implemented environment strategies, solution packaging, and application lifecycle management practices for low-code platforms preferred.Managed security, identity, and access controls within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform preferred.

Skills

It can streamline a business for simplicity, achieve digital transformation, increase service quality, improve service delivery or contain costs. It consists of integrating applications, restructuring labor resources and using software applications throughout the organization.Service Delivery Management - The manner in which an organization provides users access to IT services, which include applications, data storage and other business resources.Systems Administration - Performs a variety of functions including user management, system monitoring, system configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and access control.System Platform- A system platform refers to the underlying foundation or framework that supports and manages the operation of software applications and hardware components within a computing environment. It provides a standardized and cohesive infrastructure, allowing for the development, deployment, and integration of various technologies and services.Systems Testing - The process of testing conducted on a complete integrated system to evaluate the system's compliance with its specified requirements.Systems Integration - The process of linking together various IT systems, services and/or software to enable all of them to work functionally together.Troubleshooting - The act or process of discovering and resolving problems, disputes, or mechanical issues through a systematic, usually iterative, approach.AI Platform Reliability & Incident Management – Operating AI agents and automation platforms in production, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post‑incident remediation. Enterprise ALM & Release Management – Managing solution promotion, version control, and coordinated releases for low‑code and AI solutions across environments. Data Integration & Connector Strategy – Integrating Power Platform and AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources while managing connector risk and performance. Identity, Access & Permissions Modeling – Designing and enforcing role‑based access, service accounts, managed identities, and secure permission models. Cost Awareness & Optimization (FinOps) – Monitoring usage patterns and identifying optimization opportunities for AI, automation, and platform services. Platform Standardization & Pattern Development – Defining reusable patterns, reference architectures, and templates for AI agents, workflows, and low‑code applications. Change Management & Adoption Enablement – Supporting rollout, operational readiness, and adoption of AI‑enabled digital workplace capabilities. Vendor & Third‑Party Platform Coordination – Partnering with vendors to resolve issues, influence roadmaps, and evaluate emerging capabilities. Risk Assessment & Compliance Alignment – Assessing AI and platform solutions against security, privacy, regulatory, and audit requirements. Technical Communication & Executive Readouts – Translating platform and AI operational data into clear, decision‑ready insights for leadership.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.
