jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking an Endpoint Management Engineer to design, automate, and operate the enterprise device management platform supporting our global workforce, laboratories, manufacturing sites, and commercial field organization. This role owns hands-on engineering and operations across Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in a co-management architecture, with Hybrid Entra ID (Azure AD) joined, Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints and a multi-platform Intune estate spanning Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android — including Android-based teleconferencing and conference room systems.

Automation is central to this role. The successful candidate writes production-quality PowerShell, Bash, and .NET code, builds Intune remediation and detection scripts, and uses the Microsoft Graph API to manage the estate programmatically rather than soley through the console. We also expect fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering tools — including Claude or CoPilot — to accelerate script development, log analysis, documentation, and reporting.

Equally important is the discipline required in a regulated pharmaceutical environment. You will advance modern management objectives — Zero Trust, Conditional Access, cloud-first policy delivery, and progressive workload migration from Configuration Manager to Intune — while respecting the reliability requirements of standard corporate devices and the constraints of non-standard, purpose-built systems such as laboratory instrument controllers, manufacturing workstations, kiosks, and validated GxP endpoints. The role partners closely with Information Security, Identity, Networking, Infrastructure, Site IT, and Site Service Support teams.

Key Responsibilities

Automation, Scripting, and Development

• Design, write, and maintain production-quality PowerShell for endpoint provisioning, configuration enforcement, bulk administration, reporting, and incident remediation across the Windows estate.

• Write and maintain shell/Bash scripts for macOS configuration, compliance validation, and application delivery through Intune macOS shell scripting.

• Build and manage Intune Remediations (proactive remediations) — paired detection and remediation script logic — to identify and self-heal configuration drift, failed agents, certificate issues, and compliance gaps without user impact.

• Automate platform operations against the Microsoft Graph API, including device and policy inventory, assignment management, application lifecycle tasks, reporting extracts, and integration with adjacent systems.

• Apply engineering discipline to automation assets: source control, code review, parameterization, error handling, logging, idempotency, and controlled release through test rings.

• Convert recurring manual and Service Desk activities into automated or self-service capabilities.

Core Device Management

• Engineer and maintain Intune compliance policies across all platforms, including device health, OS version floors, and custom compliance scripts.

• Build and maintain configuration profiles and settings catalog policies, administrative templates, and custom OMA-URI/configuration profiles for Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android.

• Familiar with Windows Update for Business and update rings, feature and quality update deployments, driver and firmware update governance, macOS and iOS update policies.

• Manage monthly and out-of-band patch operations in Configuration Manager through Software Update Groups, automatic deployment rules, and maintenance windows; drive patch compliance to defined service-level targets and remediate delinquent endpoints.

• Package, test, and deploy applications across platforms — Win32 (.intunewin), MSI/MSIX, Microsoft Store, Microsoft 365 Apps, macOS PKG/DMG and shell-script apps, iOS/Android managed apps via volume purchasing — with correct detection rules, dependencies, supersedence, requirement rules, and assignment logic.

• Implement and maintain security baselines and industry benchmarks — Microsoft security baselines for Windows, Edge, and Defender; CIS Benchmarks; DISA STIG-derived controls — including deviation tracking, exception documentation, and drift detection.

• Administer the Configuration Manager hierarchy: site systems, distribution points, boundary groups, client health, content distribution, task sequences, OS deployment, and hardware/software inventory accuracy.

• Manage non-standard Windows endpoints — laboratory instrument PCs, manufacturing and shop-floor workstations, kiosks, shared and standalone systems — with tailored collections, restricted patch windows, exception handling, and documented deviations.

Identity, Conditional Access, and Endpoint Security

• Manage device identity across Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory, including Hybrid Entra ID join, Entra ID join, AD domain-bound systems, and resolution of stale, duplicate, or mis-registered device objects.

• Configure and maintain co-management settings, pilot collections, and the controlled transition of individual workloads (compliance policies, Windows Update, device configuration, client apps, Office Apps) from Configuration Manager to Intune.

• Support Conditional Access in partnership with Identity and Information Security: device-based and compliance-based grant controls, filters for devices, app protection policy requirements, and safe rollout using report-only mode and exclusion groups.

• Understand and support macOS Platform SSO with Entra ID — Secure Enclave authentication, local account creation and password sync, registration during Automated Device Enrollment — and the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in for macOS and iOS/iPadOS.

• Familiar with Zscaler Client Connector or comparable Zero Trust network access and secure web gateway agents across Windows and macOS.

• Familiar with endpoint security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker and FileVault encryption with key escrow, application control, firewall policy, and Windows LAPS.

• Deploy and maintain certificate profiles (SCEP/PKCS) and Wi-Fi (including 802.1X) across all supported platforms.

Endpoint Analytics, KPIs, and Reporting

• Define, publish, and maintain endpoint management KPIs — patch compliance rate and time-to-patch, policy and compliance conformance, application deployment success rate, agent and client health.

• Build operational and executive dashboards using Intune reporting, Configuration Manager reporting and SQL, Log Analytics, Microsoft Graph data extracts, and PowerBI.

• Use AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Cowork, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and comparable agentic tooling — to accelerate script and policy development, log and error triage, documentation authoring, data analysis, and report generation.

Compliance, Quality, and Operational Support

• Execute all platform and policy changes through the enterprise change management process, with documented impact assessment, test evidence, approvals, and rollback plans.

• Support GxP-regulated endpoints by respecting validated system boundaries, coordinating with appropriate groups on change impact, and maintaining documentation sufficient to withstand internal audit and regulatory inspection.

• Serve as escalation point for complex endpoint incidents from Endpoint Engineering Operations team and regional IT teams; perform root cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and knowledge base articles.

• Participate in an on-call or extended-coverage rotation for critical endpoint incidents and scheduled maintenance activities.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience with relevant certifications will be considered.

• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in an enterprise environment, including application packaging, OS deployment, and software update management.

• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines, and application deployment.

• Demonstrated proficiency writing and maintaining PowerShell for endpoint automation, remediation, and reporting — beyond running scripts written by others.

• Practical experience with the Microsoft Graph API for endpoint management automation or reporting.

• Working knowledge of Intune and Configuration Manager co-management, workload transition, Hybrid Entra ID join, and Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints.

• Hands-on experience managing at least two non-Windows platforms in Intune (macOS, iOS/iPadOS, or Android), including scripting or shell-based configuration on macOS.

jobs.description:
What you can expect

The ideal candidate will possess a solid SRE & Automation mindset to transform our operations from reactive ticketing to proactive engineering. You will not just resolve issues; you will code the solutions that prevent them. You can expect to work on a mix of Identity/Auth systems, Cloud Infrastructure, and Observability.

Support product teams and AI by building IaC for Identity, Directory Services, and SaaS, while maintaining a unified “Single Pane of Glass” monitoring stack.

About the Team

We are the engineering engine behind the organization's internal technology. As a modern infrastructure team, we serve as "Customer Zero" for our products, optimizing our cloud footprint while ensuring security and efficiency. We operate with a DevOps/SRE mindset to support a diverse landscape panning AWS, Azure, GCP, and critical SaaS platforms like Okta and Zoom

Responsibilities

Architecting and maintaining secure infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) flows, integrating Okta, Active Directory, and SaaS applications (Zoom, Google Workspace) to ensure seamless, secure access.
Developing and maintaining Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks to automate the provisioning of cloud resources, Kubernetes (EKS) clusters, and configuration management.
Managing and scale our hybrid monitoring stack. Configuring Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana for infrastructure metrics.
Driving the adoption of ArgoCD to manage infrastructure deployments, ensuring that Git remains the single source of truth for our configurations.
Overseeing the deployment and management of critical SaaS applications, ensuring integration with our Unified Collaboration tools (Zoom, Google, Proofpoint).
Identifying and resolving complex issues across the network, application, and identity layers. You will lead blameless post-mortems and define SLOs to ensure compliance with service-level agreements.

What we’re looking for

Have 8+ years of experience in IAM and Cloud Services. BS /MS in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent engineering experience.
Hold extensive experience creating tools and automation services with Python or Golang.
Possess a solid background in automating infrastructure using standard tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible.
Own good understanding of authentication security practices (IAM/IGA, MFA, SSO, PKI) and experience managing Okta or similar Identity Providers.
Be experienced administering major cloud platforms (AWS is primary, familiarity with Azure/GCP) an Kubernetes internals.
Have proven ability to implement and tune monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Splunk) to diagnose complex technical issues.
Have experience building pipelines with GitHub Actions/Jenkins and managing deployments via ArgoCD.
Be able to diagnose resolve complex technical issues from the physical/network layer up to the application/session level.

jobs.description:
Role Summary
This enterprise infrastructure engineer role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining complex systems within a virtualized data center environment. The position requires a seasoned professional responsible for performance optimization, disaster recovery planning, and system troubleshooting. Collaboration with cross-functional teams and mentorship of junior staff are integral to ensuring the reliability and efficiency of enterprise systems and infrastructure.

Responsibilities

- Manage and maintain the virtual data center, including performance tuning, software updates, and system implementations.
- Oversee server operating systems, database platforms, virtual host hardware, and virtual environments.
- Develop and execute plans for new data center systems, applications, and custom scripting to enhance system dependability.
- Design and implement disaster recovery and business continuity procedures, including disaster simulation exercises.
- Document deployment processes, system upgrades, and recovery procedures to ensure consistency and compliance.
- Troubleshoot level three issues related to workstations, peripherals, and enterprise applications.
- Use management tools to deploy, monitor, and debug desktop and enterprise applications across the organization.
- Adhere to change management processes by documenting and controlling system modifications to maintain a stable environment.
- Provide technical guidance and training to staff on new hardware and software solutions.
- Collaborate with teams to achieve departmental goals and ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.

Qualifications

- Seven or more years of experience in IT systems administration, with a focus on enterprise infrastructure.
- Extensive knowledge of virtual environments, including VMware vSphere, vCenter, and host hardware management.
- Proven experience with Microsoft Server OS, SQL database administration, and enterprise collaboration tools such as Exchange and Citrix.
- Strong understanding of network security, disaster recovery, and business continuity best practices.
- Current industry-standard certifications such as VCP6-DCV, MCSE, CASP, or CCA-V are preferred.
- A college degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
- Ability to work in a hybrid schedule, combining in-office and remote work.
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaborative skills.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Publishing Pay Range: $45.00 - $52.00 Hourly

This is a hybrid position and can be performed from an approved location.

jobs.description:
Remote, OR, USA | Full Time

Senior Systems Engineer (Windows)

Remote, USA

EMKS is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Independent Enterprise Testing Support Services (IETSS) contract. This project provides Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) services to support the product Software Delivery Life Cycle and Modernization efforts on behalf of our Veterans Affairs (VA) government client. In our continuing efforts to implement more of our IV&V activities, we are seeking a Sr. Windows Systems Engineer.

The Sr.Windows Systems Engineer is responsible for the administration, maintenance, support, and lifecycle management of Windows-based infrastructure supporting a large federal testing environment. This role provides Level 3 technical support for Windows servers, virtualization platforms, application hosting, and infrastructure services while collaborating with databases, Linux, network, and testing teams. The position supports a non-production environment consisting of system integration, functional, performance, and quality assurance testing systems. The administrator will be responsible for maintaining system reliability, supporting testing teams, troubleshooting complex issues, and participating in infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Administer, maintain, and support Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 environments, including Windows workstation environments as needed.

Build, configure, maintain, upgrade, migrate, and decommission Windows systems in accordance with established standards and operational requirements.

Maintain standardized system templates, configurations, file shares, Windows services, and related infrastructure documentation.

Provision, manage, and troubleshoot virtual machines and hosted services within VMware-based environments.

Monitor server capacity, disk space, memory, CPU, performance, and resource utilization to ensure systems remain available and responsive for testing activities.

Provide Level 3 troubleshooting for operating system, application hosting, service interruption, performance degradation, and infrastructure-related issues.

Support Windows-hosted testing tools and application environments, including installations, upgrades, configuration changes, access support, and issue resolution.

Support Broadcom development and testing environments, including installations, access management, and technical issue resolution.

Manage IIS and application certificates, including certificate deployment, renewal, lifecycle coordination, and troubleshooting using Venafi or similar certificate management tools.

Develop, maintain, and improve PowerShell scripts and automation solutions to streamline system administration and operational processes.

Respond to monitoring alerts, investigate outages or degraded services, participate in root cause analysis, and coordinate remediation with database, Linux, network, security, and application teams.

Support vulnerability remediation, operating system patching, security updates, BitLocker management, and compliance with organizational security requirements.

Support server access requests, permissions management, Active Directory groups, and local security groups.

Provide advanced technical support to testing personnel and cross-functional technical teams in a non-production federal testing environment.

Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical issues, coordinate across teams, and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

Required Technical/Business Tools Experience:

Windows Server administration tools and environments, including Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025.

VMware or equivalent virtualization platform for provisioning, managing, and troubleshooting virtual machines.

Active Directory, group permissions, local security groups, and access management tools.

PowerShell or equivalent scripting/automation tools used to support system administration activities.

IIS and Windows-based application hosting environments.

Certificate management tools such as Venafi or equivalent platforms.

Monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting tools used to assess system health, performance, capacity, and availability.

Patch management, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint/security compliance tools.

Ticketing, service management, and change management tools used to document work, track incidents, and coordinate support activities.

Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint for documentation, collaboration, communication, and reporting.

Education/Certifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, scientific, managerial, business, or related discipline; four years of equivalent documented experience or an Associate's Decree with two years of experience may be substituted for the Bachelor's degree.

Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate is desired.

VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization is desired.

Clearance:

U.S. Citizenship is required as is successfully passing a thorough Government background screening requiring the completion of detailed forms and fingerprinting.

Ability to obtain and maintain necessary security clearances as required for access to classified information.

This role serves as the senior technical resource for macOS device management, endpoint security, automation, and enterprise client engineering initiatives.

The role operates within the Endpoint Engineering team and is focused on delivering scalable, secure, and modern endpoint management solutions for macOS devices across the global enterprise environment. Responsibilities include endpoint lifecycle management, operating system deployment, application packaging, patch management, security compliance, automation, and platform optimization.

This position requires strong engineering capabilities, deep macOS platform expertise, and the ability to lead complex technical initiatives while supporting operational stability and modernization efforts across endpoint services.

Responsibilities
Endpoint Engineering & Platform Management

Serve as the senior macOS subject matter expert for endpoint engineering operations and escalations. Engineer, maintain, and optimize enterprise macOS management platforms including Jamf Pro and/or Iru. Design and maintain scalable endpoint provisioning and lifecycle management workflows within cloud identity environments. Manage and support macOS operating system deployment, configuration management, software deployment, and patch management processes. Maintain standardized endpoint configurations and enforce enterprise device compliance standards.

Automation & Scripting

Develop and maintain automation workflows, scripts, and tooling to improve endpoint operational efficiency and reduce manual administrative overhead. Create and maintain application packaging, deployment automation, and self-service solutions for enterprise software delivery. Write and maintain advanced Bash and Python scripts to support provisioning, compliance, reporting, monitoring, and remediation tasks. Identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement across endpoint operations.

Security & Compliance

Partner with Information Security teams to implement and maintain macOS security baselines and endpoint hardening standards. Engineer and maintain automated patching and vulnerability remediation processes. Support endpoint compliance initiatives and assist in responding to security incidents and critical vulnerabilities. Ensure endpoint management platforms align with enterprise security, auditing, and governance requirements.

Infrastructure & Operations

Monitor endpoint management platform performance, availability, and operational health. Troubleshoot and resolve complex endpoint engineering and infrastructure issues. Maintain and optimize management platform architecture in alignment with business growth and operational requirements. Participate in platform upgrades, testing, validation, and rollout activities.

Collaboration & Support

Provide Tier 3 escalation support for Service Desk and technical support teams. Collaborate with infrastructure, identity, networking, and security teams to implement integrated endpoint solutions. Work closely with business stakeholders to evaluate and deliver endpoint solutions supporting operational and business initiatives. Mentor junior engineers and contribute technical leadership within the Endpoint Engineering team.

Documentation & Standards

Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, engineering standards, and platform architecture documentation. Contribute to endpoint engineering best practices, governance standards, and operational maturity initiatives. Maintain accurate documentation for configurations, workflows, integrations, and support processes.

Qualifications
Experience

5+ years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise macOS environments. 5+ years of hands-on experience administering Jamf Pro, Iru (Kandji) platforms. Experience managing large-scale enterprise endpoint environments supporting 1000+ users. Experience supporting modern endpoint management and cloud identity platforms.

Technical Expertise

Advanced knowledge of macOS administration, configuration, and troubleshooting. Strong experience with Jamf Pro, Iru(Kandji) architecture, administration, and maintenance. Experience with macOS application packaging and deployment methodologies. Advanced knowledge of endpoint patch management concepts and methodologies. Strong scripting experience using Bash and Python. Working knowledge of Apple Business Manager, automated device enrolment, and MDM technologies. Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity providers such as Azure AD / Entra ID or Okta. Solid networking fundamentals and troubleshooting skills. Experience with ServiceNow and JIRA ticketing and workflow systems. Knowledge of endpoint security best practices and modern cybersecurity principles. Experience with endpoint compliance, monitoring, and reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

JAMF Pro 200 certification or higher. Apple platform certifications preferred. Experience with cloud-first endpoint management strategies. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and cross-platform endpoint management concepts. Experience with automation frameworks and infrastructure modernization initiatives.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Automation-first engineering mindset. Ability to operate independently in complex enterprise environments. Strong technical communication and documentation skills. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Collaborative approach to cross-functional engineering and operational work. Strong focus on platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

jobs.description:
Location: Salem Hospital, 890 Oak Street SE, Salem, OR 97301
Department: Information Services Administration
Position Type: Full Time, 40 hours/week, Exempt
Hybrid: Opportunity for 50-75% remote work; must reside in state of Oregon
Schedule: 8:00 am - 5:00 pm, Monday - Friday; rotating responsibility for 24/7 on-call
Compensation: $153,766.00 - $238,297.00/year

Build more than infrastructure. Help power the future of healthcare.

As Manager of IT Infrastructure and Digital Workplace, you will partner with executive leadership to advance strategy, strengthen resiliency, improve technology platforms, and maintain the modern infrastructure that keeps caregivers connected with one another, and patients, every day. At Salem Health, your deep experience in server operations, network engineering, and large systems will contribute to the continuous growth and improvement of one of Oregon's leading healthcare organizations.

This highly visible leadership role oversees approximately 35 team members across systems operations, networking, telecommunications, and the digital workplace. You will lead experienced technical teams, develop future leaders, and help drive innovation across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

Beyond operations, you will play a key role in forecasting infrastructure modernization, disaster recovery, cybersecurity preparedness, and enterprise resiliency initiatives, helping ensure Salem Health is ready for both today's challenges and tomorrow's opportunities.

Lead with Impact. Live with Balance.

Salem Health offers the opportunity to lead meaningful work while enjoying an exceptional quality of life. Located in the heart of the Willamette Valley, you will enjoy easy access to Oregon wine country, the Pacific Coast, mountain recreation, vibrant communities, highly rated schools, and Portland's amenities, all while benefiting from a more affordable and accessible lifestyle than many larger West Coast markets.

At Salem Health, you can build an influential career, develop talented teams, and make a lasting impact on healthcare technology while enjoying the balance that makes the Pacific Northwest such an exceptional place to call home.

What You Will Do

Strategic Leadership & Innovation

Partner with the Chief Technology Officer/Chief Information Security Officer to define and operationalize long‑term infrastructure and digital workplace strategies.Lead strategy development for your area of oversight and drive execution across multiple initiatives.Maintain and evolve strategy maps for infrastructure functions.Stay current on workplace, infrastructure, and cloud trends; evaluate emerging technologies and integrate solutions aligned with business outcomes.Advance organizational resiliency initiatives, including preparedness for natural disasters, cyber threats, and system recovery.

Team & Resource Leadership

Lead a department of approximately 35 employees, including three managers and technical teams spanning networking, systems operations, and the digital workplace.Provide coaching, mentoring, and development pathways, especially for high‑tenure teams with diverse viewpoints and skill sets.Foster a leadership culture centered on collaboration, listening, and frontline engagement; not top‑down directive management.Support retention, succession planning, and healthy team dynamics.Oversee consultants and vendor relationships across reporting departments.

Operational Excellence

Ensure reliable, secure operation of all core IT infrastructure and services across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.Oversee platforms including compute, storage, telecom, WAN, networking, endpoints, unified communications, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, and digital workplace solutions.Manage capacity, resource allocation, and day‑to‑day service performance.Lead and mature disaster recovery processes and testing.Drive modernization of WAN technologies to increase resiliency and performance.Identify and remediate technical debt through proactive monitoring and structured assessments.Support the service desk through strong alignment, clear communication, and operational readiness.

Financial & Vendor Management

Oversee division budgets and capital planning activities.Lead cost‑savings initiatives with measurable process and outcome metrics.Ensure vendors meet SLA expectations and deliver cost‑effective, high‑quality services.

Security, Risk & Compliance

Partner with Information Security to ensure all infrastructure and workplace platforms align with cybersecurity standards.Maintain compliance with regulatory and accrediting bodies (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission, HIPAA).Support organization‑wide risk management practices and system hardening.

Continuous Improvement

Apply Lean/Kaizen methodologies to drive measurable improvements in operations, efficiency, and user experience.Act as a Lean Sensei for multiple team members, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Leadership On‑Call

Participate in the enterprise‑wide IS leadership on‑call rotation (approximately every 16 weeks).Provide high‑level decision support for critical after‑hours incidents and escalations.

What We're Looking For

Technical & Strategic Abilities

Experience working in, and strong familiarity with, on-premises infrastructure footprints, including technical debt prioritization.Ability to manage DR/resilience design when a critical system, such as the EMR, is hosted by a third party outside of the organization’s direct infrastructure control.Strategic foresight to consider resilience and continuity when critical systems run on infrastructure owned outside the organization.Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and align them with organizational strategy and real‑world constraints.Familiarity with resiliency planning, disaster recovery, and enterprise risk management.A balanced orientation toward technical depth, operational excellence, and people leadership.

Background & Experience

Progressive experience that demonstrates both technical competency and leadership capability, not exclusively long‑tenured management without hands‑on technical grounding.Demonstrated success partnering across complex organizations, particularly in healthcare or other highly regulated industries.

Leadership & Behavioral Strengths

A collaborative, people‑centered leadership style that values input from frontline experts.Ability to navigate differing opinions, especially among highly skilled, high‑tenure technical staff, with diplomacy and clarity.Strong relationship‑building skills across clinical, technical, and operational teams.Comfort balancing strategic vision with operational needs, jumping in where needed to “keep the lights on.”High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to establish trust quickly.

Required Qualifications

Master's degree. Eight years of professional experience within technology, preferably in a hospital or clinical setting. Five years of experience in management of complex projects and implementation of systems. Five years of experience managing projects and/or applications. Three years of manager or director-level experience.

Why Salem Health?

Salem Health is a Top Workplace in Oregon, known for fostering a supportive culture where your contributions truly matter. As an award-winning, independent health care system, we serve our region through Salem Hospital, multiple community clinics and West Valley Hospital, ensuring broad access to high-quality care.

We believe in empowering our teams. Through Lean principles, staff help drive innovation and solve real problems. We also invest in your growth with professional development, tuition assistance, and clear career pathways. At Salem Health, you’ll find more than a job, you’ll find purpose, connection, and room to thrive.

Salem Health Hospitals and Clinics is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status or condition protected by law.

Salem Health Hospitals and Clinics is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for applicants. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact my.recruiter@salemhealth.org.

Our Values

Respect | Belonging | Accountability | Transparency

Department

Information Technology

Job Summary

The End User Computing (EUC) Engineer is responsible for designing, supporting, maintaining, and optimizing the hospital's end user computing environment to ensure clinicians, staff, and administrators have reliable and secure access to technology resources. This role provides advanced technical support for endpoint devices, operating systems, applications, and mobility solutions, with a strong focus on delivering a stable, compliant, and user-friendly experience in a healthcare setting. The Engineer partners closely with clinical and non-clinical teams to address technology needs, troubleshoot complex issues, and contribute to projects that enhance patient care through technology.

Essential Functions:

Endpoint Deployment & Configuration
o Build, configure, and deploy desktops, laptops, tablets, thin clients, and mobile devices using enterprise imaging and management tools.
o Ensure devices meet hospital security, compliance, and operational standards prior to release.

(15%)Advanced Technical Support
o Provide Tier II/III support for escalated incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
o Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and peripheral issues in clinical and administrative environments.
o Partner with EUC Support and Help Desk teams to ensure resolution and knowledge transfer.
(15%)Systems & Application Management
o Administer and support Microsoft 365, Intune, SCCM, and other enterprise endpoint management solutions.
o Package, test, and deploy applications, patches, and updates to the endpoint environment.
o Maintain and optimize Group Policy Objects (GPOs), login scripts, and device configurations.
(15%)Healthcare Technology Integration
o Support clinical workstations, Workstations on Wheels (WoWs), printers, and medical-grade peripherals.
o Collaborate with clinical application teams (e.g., Epic Analysts, Nursing Informatics, Clin. Apps) to ensure endpoint compatibility, performance, and workflow support.
(15%)Security & Compliance
o Enforce endpoint security policies, including encryption, endpoint detection and response (EDR), conditional access, and mobile device management.
o Participate in vulnerability remediation, patch management, and compliance reporting activities.
o Support HIPAA and other regulatory requirements by ensuring endpoint security and data protection measures.
(15%)Project Participation & Execution
o Contribute to enterprise IT projects such as operating system upgrades, device lifecycle refreshes, and mobility initiatives.
o Assist with design, testing, and rollout of new endpoint standards, technologies, and configurations.
o Document project deliverables, lessons learned, and standard operating procedures.
(10%)Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
o Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles.
o Provide technical training and guidance to junior staff and end users as needed.
(10%)Continuous Improvement
o Monitor system performance, identify recurring issues, and recommend solutions to improve reliability and efficiency.
o Stay current with emerging EUC technologies, industry best practices, and healthcare IT trends.
(5%)

Bachelor's Degree Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field required; equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of degree.

7-9 years of IT experience with at least 5 years focused on end user computing required.

Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Windows Operating Systems, Intune, SCCM, Active Directory, Group Policy.Experience with mobile device management (MDM/MAM), such as Intune, JAMF or Citrix XenMobile.Familiarity with clinical workflows and healthcare endpoint technologies.Strong troubleshooting skills in hardware, OS, and application environments.

Shift

Days (United States of America)

Regular

jobs.title: Endpoint Management Engineer
jobs.summary: The Endpoint Management Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all managed workstations across the firm consistently receive and successfully apply required software deployments — including application updates, operating system patches, BIOS/firmware...
jobs.description:
The Endpoint Management Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all managed workstations across the firm consistently receive and successfully apply required software deployments — including application updates, operating system patches, BIOS/firmware updates, and hardware driver updates. This role serves as the deployment authority for the workstation environment: owning the deployment calendar, coordinating release timing with other engineers, and ensuring that all workstation deployments are accompanied by the appropriate change control documentation. The role maintains a strong compliance posture by monitoring deployment success rates, identifying and remediating gaps, and validating that updates reach their intended targets across both Windows and macOS endpoints within established timeframes. The individual in this role operates with a high degree of independence, self directs their workload, and is capable of leading projects from inception through completion with minimal oversight. Forthe full job description, please click on the More Info icon.
Duties and Responsibilities
Primary

Serves as the deployment authority for the workstation environment — owns the deployment calendar and coordinates with other engineers across the group to determine scheduling and sequencing for all software, update, and configuration deployments pushed to firm workstations.Creates and manages change control tickets for all workstation deployments in accordance with firm change management policy, ensuring that required documentation, approvals, and risk assessments are completed prior to deployment.Monitors and enforces workstation software compliance for all deployed applications, operating system updates, BIOS/firmware updates, and hardware driver updates across the firm's managed Windows and macOS device fleet.Tracks deployment success rates via SCCM/ConfigMgr, Intune, and Jamf Pro; identifies noncompliant, unreachable, or failing endpoints and drives remediation to closure.Owns the deployment pipeline for BIOS/firmware and driver updates across the Windows device fleet, including packaging, testing, staged rollout, and post-deployment validation (primarily Lenovo hardware).Manages macOS workstation compliance in Jamf Pro, including application deployment, macOS update enforcement, configuration profile compliance, and device inventory accuracy.Prioritizes security-relevant application and OS updates to ensure timely workstation delivery in alignment with firm policy; coordinates with information security when patch timelines or compliance gaps require escalation.Partners with information security as needed to provide deployment compliance data, reporting, and evidence for audits or vulnerability management reviews — serving as the subject-matter expert on workstation software state.Develops and maintains compliance dashboards and reporting for software update health across Windows and macOS endpoints, highlighting trends, persistent failures, and remediation status for IT leadership.Authors and maintains deployment runbooks, compliance procedures, and exception-handling documentation to support consistent operations and knowledge transfer.Identifies systemic causes of deployment failures (e.g., client health issues, network constraints, policy conflicts, Jamf enrollment gaps) and implements durable solutions rather than one-off fixes.Leads projects independently as required — defining scope, coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines, and delivering outcomes with minimal direct oversight.Collaborates with the Applications Engineering team on new application deployments to build compliance monitoring into rollouts from the outset, for both Windows and macOS platforms.Evaluates and recommends tooling improvements or process enhancements that increase deployment reliability and compliance visibility across the full workstation fleet.Provides escalation support for complex deployment or compliance issues affecting end-user productivity.Develops and maintains end-user communications and guidance aimed at improving update compliance — including messaging around device availability during deployment windows — and works collaboratively with end users to identify software gaps and develop practical solutions that increase overall compliance rates.
Secondary
Performs other duties as assigned.
Minimum Qualification
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience in the computer/technical industry.
Experience
5–8 years of experience in endpoint or workstation management, systems administration, or IT operations with a demonstrable focus on patch management, software deployment, and compliance across Windows environments. Experience with macOS management is a plus. Experience in a law firm or professional services environment is preferred.
Special Knowledge
Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/ConfigMgr), Windows Server Update Services (WSUS), Microsoft Intune, Active Directory, and Group Policy. Jamf Pro for macOS workstation management, including policy deployment, configuration profiles, and patch enforcement. Familiarity with CyberArk EPM or similar endpoint privilege management tools. Knowledge of BIOS/UEFI firmware update mechanisms and hardware driver management, preferably in a Lenovo environment. Familiarity with Azure services including Entra ID is a plus.
Technical Skills
Proficiency with PowerShell scripting for automation of compliance reporting, remediation tasks, and deployment workflows on Windows. Familiarity with Bash or shell scripting for macOS automation within Jamf is a plus. Solid understanding of Windows operating system internals as they relate to update and patch application on workstations. Experience querying SCCM/Intune data via SQL or built-in reporting to build compliance dashboards. Hands-on experience packaging and deploying software and firmware updates in an enterprise Windows environment. Familiarity with application packaging tools (InstallShield, AdminStudio, or similar) is a plus. Experience with Lenovo System Update, Lenovo Thin Installer, or Lenovo Device Manager for firmware/driver management is preferred. Experience with macOS software packaging and deployment via Jamf (pkg, DMG, scripts) is a plus.
Attributes
Strong self-starter who identifies problems independently and drives them to resolution without waiting for direction. Demonstrated ability to manage and lead projects end-to-end, including planning, coordination, and delivery. Meticulous attention to detail in tracking compliance gaps and documenting findings. Excellent analytical and diagnostic skills, including the ability to trace complex deployment failures across multiple system layers on both Windows and macOS. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical compliance data into concise summaries for non-technical stakeholders. Collaborative and team-oriented, with the ability to work effectively across IT functions. Comfortable engaging directly with end users to understand compliance barriers, communicate expectations, and develop pragmatic solutions that improve deployment outcomes across the firm.
Qualifications
Ability to work independently under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet strict deadlines. Comfortable operating in an environment where update timelines are driven by security and compliance requirements. Ability to see complex, multi-phase projects through to completion.
Working Conditions
Job is performed remotely but may require occasional travel into the office; is subject to time pressures and constraints and is often dependent on input from others.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by persons assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications and skills required of personnel so classified. The firm reserves the right to revise or modify this job description at any time.

Job Title
Systems Engineer - IT Salesforce Platform

Position Overview

Shaw Industries Group, Inc. is a leader in flooring and other surface solutions designed for residential housing, commercial spaces and outdoor environments. Leveraging strengths in design, innovation and operational excellence, the company takes a people-centered, customer-focused, and growth-minded approach to meet diverse market needs. It creates differentiated customer experiences through its expansive portfolio of brands: Anderson Tuftex, COREtec, Shaw Floors, Patcraft, Philadelphia Commercial, Shaw Contract, Shaw Sports Turf, Shawgrass, Southwest Greens, Watershed Geo and more. Headquartered in Dalton, Georgia, Shaw is a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc. with more than $6 billion in annual sales and 18,000 associates worldwide.

Position Overview

Our mission is to design, engineer, and continuously evolve enterprise-grade system solutions that enable Shaw to remain a market leader. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a critical role in architecting and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions on the Salesforce platform (SFDC), the world's leading Customer Relationship Management system.

This role goes beyond development to include solution architecture, technical leadership, and strategic alignment with business objectives. You will partner closely with Commercial Sales, Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture, and cross-functional technology teams to design future-state capabilities across Desktop and Mobile platforms.

This position offers a dynamic opportunity to lead complex initiatives, influence platform strategy, and mentor engineering talent while driving innovation within a cloud-first ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Design
Support the end-to-end design and architecture of Salesforce-based solutions aligned to enterprise standards and long-term platform strategy.Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing technical solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and integration frameworks.Define and enforce design patterns, coding standards, and development best practices across the Salesforce ecosystem.
Technical Leadership
Serve as a technical expert and subject matter expert for Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations, and platform capabilities).Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers, fostering engineering excellence and continuous learning.Provide oversight and governance for development activities, including code reviews, CI/CD practices, and release management.
Enterprise Integration & Data Strategy
Design and implement complex integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems (e.g., middleware, MDM, data platforms).Ensure robust data architecture, including data quality, governance, and performance optimization.Collaborate with integration teams to define API strategies and event-driven architecture.
Delivery & Execution
Lead the development and implementation of complex features, enhancements, and large-scale initiatives.Allocate time across design, development, troubleshooting, and production support, with a strong emphasis on high-impact engineering work.Drive automation, DevOps, and continuous delivery improvements within the Salesforce ecosystem.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with business leaders and product stakeholders to shape roadmaps and prioritize initiatives.Communicate technical solutions and trade-offs effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Business teams on technology capabilities and innovation opportunities.
Quality, Security & Compliance
Ensure solutions adhere to security, compliance, and governance standards, including MFA, data protection, and regulatory requirements.Establish and maintain testing strategies, quality assurance practices, and performance benchmarks.Conduct solution reviews to ensure scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).3 - 5 + years of experience in enterprise application development, with deep expertise in Salesforce platform engineering preferred.Proven experience in solution architecture, technical leadership, and large-scale system implementations.Strong experience in Salesforce technologies: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, APIs, and platform configuration.Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, middleware platforms such as Informatica, MuleSoft, TIBCO).Strong understanding of data modeling, system integration patterns, and cloud architecture principles.Familiarity with DevOps practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with content management systems (e.g., Kentico or similar platforms)Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWSExperience with monitoring, logging, or observability toolsFamiliarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processesExperience supporting high-traffic or customer-facing websites
How We Work

Our team operates in a highly collaborative, remote-first environment. We leverage Microsoft Teams for communication and use Agile/Scrum methodologies to plan and deliver work. Our technology stack includes ASP.NET, Web APIs, and SQL Server, supporting applications hosted primarily in cloud environments.

Shaw Core Competencies

Strategic Thinking & Execution - Aligns technical solutions with long-term business strategy.

Technical Leadership - Guides teams, sets standards, and drives engineering excellence.

Stakeholder Influence - Builds strong partnerships and communicates effectively at all levels.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement - Identifies opportunities to enhance systems and processes.

Adaptability & Change Leadership - Thrives in dynamic, evolving environments.

Trust & Accountability - Demonstrates ownership, transparency, and reliability.

Work Shift
8 Hr non-rotating shift, Hrs fall to in punch day, Observed Calendar, shift starts AM

Shaw Industries is an equal opportunity employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:
At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident.

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you.

Role Summary

The Lead Desktop Engineer - End User Compute (EUC) serves as a senior technical leader responsible for the engineering, administration, operational health, security, and continuous improvement of the enterprise endpoint environment.

This role functions as a recognized subject matter expert across end-user computing technologies and is responsible for driving platform modernization, implementing new solutions, establishing technical standards, and ensuring the reliability and security of the organization's endpoint ecosystem.

The Lead Desktop Engineer provides technical leadership across desktop engineering initiatives, mentors junior team members, and leads the design and implementation of endpoint technologies that support business productivity, security, and operational excellence.

This position requires extensive experience managing large-scale enterprise endpoint environments and the ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from concept through production deployment and operational support.

Responsibilities

End User Compute Platform Leadership:

Serve as a senior technical leader for enterprise endpoint platforms and workplace technologies. Lead technical design, implementation, and administration of end-user computing solutions. Establish and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, and platform best practices. Act as a primary escalation point for complex endpoint and platform issues. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Desktop Engineers and Senior Desktop Engineers.

Endpoint Engineering & Administration

Engineer, administer, and maintain enterprise endpoint management platforms. Ensure operational health, stability, and performance across the endpoint fleet. Develop device configuration standards and security baselines. Manage operating system lifecycle activities including deployments, upgrades, and patch management. Support Windows, macOS, virtual desktop, and cloud-based endpoint platforms as required.

Modern Workplace Solutions

Lead the implementation of new technologies that improve user experience, security, automation, and operational efficiency. Evaluate emerging technologies and provide technical recommendations. Design and implement modern endpoint management capabilities, including Modern Device Management (MDM), zero-touch provisioning, endpoint security controls, virtual desktop technologies, Cloud PC solutions, and Digital Employee Experience platforms. Develop technical designs, implementation plans, testing strategies, and deployment methodologies.

Security & Compliance

Partner with Information Security teams to strengthen endpoint security posture. Implement and maintain endpoint security controls and compliance requirements, including appropriate use of Microsoft Defender Antivirus and Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC). Support vulnerability management, remediation, and risk-reduction initiatives. Assist with incident response activities involving endpoint technologies. Ensure endpoint platforms align with corporate security policies and regulatory requirements.

Automation & Process Improvement

Develop automation solutions to improve operational efficiency and platform scalability. Leverage scripting and automation technologies to reduce manual effort. Continuously identify opportunities for operational improvement. Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles.

Project Leadership

Lead endpoint-focused projects and engineering initiatives. Coordinate technical activities across infrastructure, security, network, and support teams. Manage technical deliverables, implementation schedules, and platform readiness activities. Ensure successful transition of new solutions into ongoing operations.

Qualifications

Required:

7+ years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise endpoint environments. 5+ years of experience administering large-scale enterprise desktop management platforms. Advanced experience supporting Windows endpoint environments. Experience with modern endpoint management technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Microsoft Entra ID, and Jamf Pro. Familiarity with endpoint security capabilities such as Microsoft Defender Antivirus and Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC). Strong experience with PowerShell and automation. Experience implementing endpoint security technologies and controls. Experience leading enterprise technology deployments and platform modernization efforts. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills. Excellent communication and technical leadership abilities.

Preferred

Experience supporting environments with 5,000+ endpoints. Experience with Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Citrix Experience with Microsoft Defender Antivirus, Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC), CrowdStrike, Tanium, Nexthink, or similar enterprise management and security solutions. Experience with endpoint vulnerability management programs. Experience in financial services or other highly regulated environments. Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, Jamf, or security certifications.

Leadership Expectations

Be recognized as a technical subject matter expert within End User Compute. Lead through technical expertise and influence. Independently drive complex engineering initiatives. Mentor and develop junior team members. Make sound technical decisions balancing user experience, reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Promote automation, standardization, and continuous improvement. Collaborate effectively across technology teams and business stakeholders.

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role.

Work Flexibility

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home.

jobs.description:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

As an Information System Engineer in our IT Digital Employee department (reporting to the Manager, End User Engineering), you will design, implement, and support Zscaler’s global end-user computing (EUC) environment across Windows, macOS, BYOD, and Mobile platforms. Based in Bangalore, India (Hybrid), you will collaborate with IT, Security, and Platform Engineering teams to build secure, cloud-first workspaces fully aligned to Zero Trust principles—balancing priority operational escalations with high-value engineering projects.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

- Deploy, configure, and maintain corporate-managed endpoints (Windows/macOS/BYOD/Mobile) in alignment with Zscaler security baselines, least-privilege standards, and automated lifecycle workflows.

- Execute vulnerability management workflows using CrowdStrike and Zscaler UVM (Avalor); triage, prioritize, and track risk remediation using Jira, ServiceNow, and executive compliance dashboards.

- Monitor system performance and user satisfaction using Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) and Omnissa, implementing self-healing policies and proactive automation to balance security with productivity.

- Participate and contribute to complex endpoint issues and security threats, conducting root cause analysis (RCA) and documenting actionable SOPs and runbooks for support teams.

- Contribute for technical initiatives including platform upgrades, virtualization pilots, and security tool rollouts while working cross-functionally across IT Operations, Security, and business leaders.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

- You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

- You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

- You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

- You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

- 4+ years in enterprise EUC, endpoint management, or desktop engineering within cloud-first environments.

- Deep proficiency in Windows and macOS administration alongside UEM platforms such as CrowdStrike, Jamf, Microsoft Intune/MEM, Workspace ONE, and ServiceNow.

- Proven track record running vulnerability management, patch compliance, and risk mitigation at enterprise scale.

- Strong technical diagnostic skills across device security, OS performance, network stacks, hardware, and productivity software.

- Solid foundation in Zero Trust architecture, excellent stakeholder communication skills, and the flexibility for after-hours on-call or on-site support during major incidents.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Hands-on experience writing scripts in PowerShell, Python, or equivalent languages to automate routine operational tasks.

- Prior experience with end-user digital experience monitoring tools such as Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) or Omnissa.

- Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator, Jamf Certified, CrowdStrike, or Zscaler credentials.

jobs.description:
Prevent problems. Improve environments. Make IT easier to support.

ET&T is looking for an experienced "Technical Alignment Engineer" who believes the best support ticket is the one that never needs to be opened.

This is not a traditional help desk role. Your primary responsibility will be to proactively evaluate, document, standardize, and improve our clients’ technology environments.

You will conduct regular remote and on-site reviews, compare client environments against ET&T’s defined technical and cybersecurity standards, and remediate issues within an established scope. When a finding requires greater planning, investment, or architectural change, you will clearly document the need and help transition it into a properly scoped project.

The right person combines broad technical knowledge with curiosity, organization, sound judgment, and exceptional documentation habits.

What You’ll Do

Audit client environments against ET&T’s technical, operational, and cybersecurity standards.
Remediate identified gaps using approved standards and procedures.
Determine whether findings should be resolved immediately, scheduled as controlled changes, discussed with the client, or scoped as projects.
Maintain accurate client documentation, including infrastructure, applications, credentials, assets, network diagrams, procedures, and client-specific support information.
Conduct regular client site visits to complete physical assessments, remediation, and documentation.
Build trusted client relationships through clear communication and professional follow-through.
Identify risks, recurring problems, aging infrastructure, and opportunities for long-term improvement.
Provide clear technical handoffs to service leadership, project teams, and account management.
Serve as a Level 2 escalation resource as needed.
Help improve ET&T’s technical standards and internal processes based on what you encounter in the field.

Our standards cover a broad range of areas, including servers, workstations, networking, firewalls, backups, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, identity, security tools, and documentation.

You’ll Be Successful Here If You

Prefer preventing recurring problems over repeatedly fixing symptoms.
Can methodically assess an unfamiliar technology environment.
Treat documentation as part of completing the technical work.
Follow standards while recognizing when an exception or escalation is necessary.
Can balance technical quality, client impact, risk, effort, and urgency.
Communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical people.
Take ownership of findings through remediation, escalation, or documented handoff.
Are comfortable working independently while remaining accountable to a team.

jobs.description:
Senior macOS System Engineer

$110000 - $125000 per year | Charlotte, NC | On-site | Permanent

A bit about us:

We are a large, established organization with a diverse portfolio of businesses and a global technology environment. Our enterprise technology teams build and support the secure, reliable, and modern platforms that enable employees to work effectively across locations and business units.

The Endpoint Engineering team is responsible for delivering scalable device-management solutions, strengthening endpoint security, and modernizing the employee technology experience. The team works closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Identity, Networking, and Support teams to ensure endpoint services remain secure, resilient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to serve as a senior technical authority for macOS engineering within a complex, large-scale enterprise environment. You will have the ability to shape endpoint strategy, lead modernization and automation initiatives, and influence how Apple devices are securely managed throughout their lifecycle.

You will join a collaborative technology organization where you can:

Take ownership of enterprise macOS engineering and platform architecture

Lead high-impact automation, security, and modernization initiatives

Work with modern endpoint-management and cloud-identity technologies

Solve complex technical challenges across a large, distributed environment

Partner with experienced professionals across Security, Identity, Infrastructure, and Networking

Mentor other engineers and help establish endpoint-engineering standards and best practices

Job Details

Position Overview

The Senior macOS Systems Engineer is responsible for engineering, maintaining, automating, and securing the organization’s macOS endpoint ecosystem and its supporting infrastructure. This individual will serve as a senior technical resource for macOS device management, endpoint security, automation, and enterprise client-engineering initiatives.

As a member of the Endpoint Engineering team, this role will focus on delivering scalable, secure, and modern management solutions for macOS devices across a global enterprise environment. Responsibilities include endpoint lifecycle management, operating-system deployment, application packaging, software distribution, patch management, security compliance, automation, and platform optimization.

The ideal candidate brings deep macOS platform expertise, strong engineering and scripting capabilities, and the ability to lead complex technical initiatives while maintaining the stability and reliability of critical endpoint services.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering and Platform Management

Serve as the senior macOS subject-matter expert for endpoint-engineering operations, technical initiatives, and escalations.

Engineer, administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise macOS management platforms, including Jamf Pro and Iru.

Design scalable endpoint-provisioning and lifecycle-management workflows integrated with cloud-based identity environments.

Manage macOS operating-system deployment, configuration management, software distribution, and patch-management processes.

Establish and maintain standardized endpoint configurations across the enterprise.

Implement and enforce device-compliance policies and enterprise technology standards.

Evaluate platform capabilities and recommend improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, security, and the employee experience.

Automation and Scripting

Develop and maintain scripts, tooling, and automated workflows that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual administration.

Create and maintain application packages, deployment automations, and self-service software-delivery solutions.

Write advanced Bash and Python scripts supporting device provisioning, compliance, reporting, monitoring, remediation, and lifecycle management.

Identify opportunities to automate repeatable processes and improve the overall maturity of endpoint operations.

Build reliable and reusable solutions that can scale across a large enterprise environment.

Security and Compliance

Partner with Information Security teams to establish and maintain macOS security baselines and endpoint-hardening standards.

Engineer automated patching, vulnerability-management, and remediation processes.

Support endpoint-compliance programs and respond to critical vulnerabilities and security incidents.

Ensure endpoint-management platforms align with enterprise security, auditing, risk, and governance requirements.

Develop monitoring and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into endpoint health, vulnerabilities, and compliance status.

Infrastructure and Operations

Monitor the performance, availability, capacity, and overall health of endpoint-management platforms.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex macOS, endpoint-engineering, and supporting infrastructure issues.

Maintain and optimize platform architecture in alignment with business growth and operational requirements.

Lead or participate in platform upgrades, migrations, testing, validation, and enterprise rollout activities.

Proactively identify technical risks and implement solutions that improve platform stability and resilience.

Collaboration and Technical Leadership

Provide Tier 3 escalation support to Service Desk and technical support teams.

Collaborate with Infrastructure, Identity, Networking, Information Security, and other engineering teams to deliver integrated endpoint solutions.

Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate requirements and implement solutions supporting operational and strategic initiatives.

Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across the Endpoint Engineering team.

Lead technical discussions, communicate recommendations, and help drive decisions related to macOS endpoint strategy.

Documentation and Standards

Create and maintain technical documentation, engineering standards, operational procedures, and platform-architecture materials.

Document configurations, integrations, automation workflows, troubleshooting procedures, and support processes.

Contribute to endpoint-engineering governance, best practices, and operational-maturity initiatives.

Ensure technical documentation remains accurate, accessible, and aligned with the current environment.

Qualifications

Required Experience

Five or more years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise macOS environments.

Five or more years of hands-on experience administering Jamf Pro, Iru/Kandji, or comparable Apple device-management platforms.

Experience managing large-scale endpoint environments supporting at least 1,000 users or devices.

Experience with modern endpoint-management platforms and cloud-based identity solutions.

Demonstrated experience leading complex endpoint-engineering, automation, or infrastructure-modernization initiatives.

Experience providing advanced technical support and resolving escalated enterprise endpoint issues.

Technical Expertise

Advanced knowledge of macOS administration, configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting.

Strong experience with Jamf Pro and Iru/Kandji architecture, administration, integrations, and ongoing maintenance.

Experience with macOS application packaging, software distribution, and deployment methodologies.

Advanced understanding of endpoint patch-management and vulnerability-remediation practices.

Strong scripting and automation experience using Bash and Python.

Working knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, and Apple MDM technologies.

Experience integrating endpoint-management platforms with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID or Okta.

Knowledge of certificate-based authentication, conditional access, and modern identity-management concepts.

Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and the ability to troubleshoot endpoint connectivity issues.

Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing and workflow-management platforms.

Knowledge of endpoint-security best practices and modern cybersecurity principles.

Experience developing endpoint-compliance, monitoring, inventory, and reporting solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Jamf Certified Tech certification or higher, including Jamf 200 or an equivalent current certification.

Apple platform or Apple device-support certifications.

Experience implementing cloud-first endpoint-management strategies.

Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and cross-platform endpoint-management environments.

Experience with automation frameworks, infrastructure-as-code practices, or API-driven integrations.

Experience supporting enterprise platform migrations or modernization programs.

Familiarity with zero-touch provisioning and identity-based device-enrollment workflows.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities

Automation-first engineering mindset

Ability to work independently within a complex enterprise environment

Strong technical communication and documentation skills

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent initiatives

Collaborative approach to cross-functional engineering and operations

Strong commitment to security, platform reliability, and operational excellence

Ability to balance long-term engineering improvements with immediate operational needs

Comfortable providing technical leadership and influencing decisions without direct authority
