jobs.description:
Dexian has an immediate opportunity available for a detail-oriented and motivated Endpoint Administrator with MS Intune experience to manage, maintain, and optimize a unified endpoint management environment for our premier aerospace customer. The Endpoint Administrator will be the primary point of contact for the deployment, configuration, compliance, and security of all corporate-owned and BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) endpoints. Utilizing the Microsoft 365 stack-specifically Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID-you will ensure seamless, secure hardware and software lifecycles across Windows and iOS platforms.

A typical workday may consist of the following duties as directed by the client:

Policy & Profile Management: Build, test, and deploy Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines to standardize client environments.
Application Packaging & Deployment: Package, test, and distribute internal and third-party software updates, web links, and store apps across the enterprise.
Modern Provisioning: Administer and monitor modern device deployment systems, such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager, ensuring a zero-touch or minimal-touch provisioning pipeline for new hires.
Identity & Access Control: Collaborate with identity teams to manage device registration, primary user changes, group memberships, and targeted Conditional Access enforcement.
Troubleshooting & Escalations: Act as the Tier 2/3 escalation point for device enrollment failures, application installation blocks, and profile synchronization issues.
Reporting & Governance: Monitor Intune reporting dashboards daily to identify non-compliant devices, update patch status deficiencies, and remediate systemic configuration drift.
Documentation: Maintain clear, concise documentation outlining deployment processes, app packaging standards, and device lifecycle flows.

REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS:
To be successful in this role, you should possess the following skills:

Security Stack Exposure: Familiarity integrating Intune with security tools like Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or implementing data protection via MAM (Mobile Application Management) without full device enrollment.
Problem-Solving & Analytical Rigor: A structured, logical approach to debugging deployment failures, policy conflicts, and log file analysis.
Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to explain technical enrollment steps or security restrictions clearly and empathetically to non-technical business professionals.
Adaptability: Curiosity and willingness to stay current with Microsoft's continuous cloud release notes, feature changes, and best-practice evolutions.
JAMF experience, desired

To be eligible for this position, you must meet or exceed each of the following:

Experience: 6-8 years of progressive experience in IT systems administration, with a minimum of 2-3 years dedicated specifically to managing and deploying policies within Microsoft Intune (Cloud-only or Hybrid/co-management configurations).
Technical Ecosystem Knowledge: Solid foundation in Microsoft 365 workloads, including Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory), Conditional Access policies, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
OS Support: Demonstrated experience configuring, enrolling, and troubleshooting Windows 10/11 endpoints. Basic exposure to managing mobile operating systems (iOS) via MDM (Mobile Device Management) profiles.
Scripting Essentials: Basic proficiency with PowerShell for writing, editing, and deploying automated scripts or application wrappers to endpoints.
Core Infrastructure: Solid understanding of core networking and identity concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and modern identity provisioning.

This position requires an active Department of Defense security clearance at the SECRET level or ability to obtain and maintain this clearance.

LOCATION:

This is an on-site position and the successful candidate may be based in one of the following locations: El Segundo, CA, Chantilly, VA or Colorado Springs, CO.

EDUCATION and CERTIFICATIONS:

Associate's degree or higher required
Possession of or progress toward the Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) certification.

COMPENSATION:

Dexian reasonably expects to offer $38.00 - $45.00 per hour for this position based on location, skills and experience. Additional benefits include generous time off, health, vision and dental insurance and matching 401k.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Submit/Pass a 10-year background check, criminal history, drug screening, and fingerprints.
Valid driver's license/Real-ID with clean driver's history.
Applicants must have a strong work ethic, be extremely organized and detail-oriented, be a self-starter with excellent time management, problem solving, and multitasking skills.
Excellent face-to-face customer service skills - at least 1 year experience in a customer service position, such as: call center, retail, or other customer facing role.
Demonstrated problem solving skills with ability to research, resolve and complete tasks within pre-determined deadlines and schedules.
Able to process work quickly and accurately despite interruptions, changing timelines and priorities, on a regular basis.
Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Excel, and Word programs.
Working knowledge of app/database ticketing systems. Knowledge of ServiceNow, a plus.
Position may require dexterity and ability to sit, stand, walk extended distances.

Dexian stands at the forefront of Talent + Technology solutions with a presence spanning more than 70 locations worldwide and a team exceeding 10,000 professionals. As one of the largest technology and professional staffing companies and one of the largest minority-owned staffing companies in the United States, Dexian combines over 30 years of industry expertise with cutting-edge technologies to deliver comprehensive global services and support.

jobs.description:
## **Job Description:**
The Endpoint Administrator administers, configures, and maintains the University's endpoint computing environment, ensuring reliable, secure, and effective operation of end-user devices and related management platforms.
The position applies standardized practices and professional judgment to administer endpoint technologies, troubleshoot complex issues, and recommend improvements to configurations, processes, and tools used across the University.
Its primary responsibility is the configuration, administration, and ongoing optimization of endpoint management platforms and related system behavior.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
1\. Endpoint Administration and Lifecycle Management (35%)
- Administer the configuration, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of Apple and Windows endpoint systems across academic, administrative, and shared computing environments.
- Apply standard images, configuration baselines, and management policies to ensure consistency, security, and operational reliability of endpoint devices.
- Coordinate with vendors and internal partners regarding supported hardware standards, warranty issues, and replacement planning.
- Participate in planned endpoint deployments and refresh activities, providing technical oversight and troubleshooting for complex issues.
2\. Endpoint Management Tools and Configuration ( 25%)
- Manage specific applications crucial for end-user computing, such as Microsoft Configuration Manager/System Center, Intune, and Windows Autopilot.
- Configure, maintain, and optimize endpoint management platforms, including deployment profiles, policies, application packages, and update mechanisms.
- Independently analyze endpoint behavior, deployment outcomes, and configuration issues to resolve problems and improve reliability and performance.
3\. Advanced Technical Support and Issue Resolution (15%)
- Serve as an escalation resource for complex endpoint-related issues that require in-depth technical analysis and systems-level troubleshooting.
- Provide targeted technical assistance for non-routine issues.
- Document resolutions, configurations, and known issues to support consistent administration and future problem resolution.
4\. Inventory and Endpoint Standards Compliance (15%)
- Maintain accurate endpoint inventory records and ensure devices comply with established configuration, asset, and lifecycle standards.
- Apply defined standards and procedures related to endpoint administration and technology refresh cycles.
5\. Endpoint Security and Configuration Compliance (10%)
- Maintain currency with issues related to virus and malware prevention, protection, and recovery.
- Apply approved security configurations, patching standards, and compliance controls to endpoint systems in coordination with Information Security guidance.
- Identify configuration risks or recurring issues and recommend corrective actions within established security frameworks.
## **Requirements:**
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Professional experience (approximately 2-4 years) administering endpoint or desktop systems in a managed environment
- Proficient technical knowledge of macOS, Windows, MS Office, and enterprise endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Configuration Manager, Intune, and Windows Autopilot
- Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve non-routine endpoint issues using professional judgment rather than scripted procedures
- Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities and manage multiple concurrent technical tasks
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in a higher education or enterprise computing environment
- Familiarity with endpoint configuration standards, deployment tools, or automation
- Understanding of basic networking, authentication, and device security concepts
Working Conditions and Physical Requirements
- Standard office and campus environment; movement between campus locations as needed
- Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and handle light to medium weights (up to 35 pounds).
- Role primarily involves systems administration and analytical work with limited physical handling of equipment
- May require occasional evening or weekend work tied to deployments or maintenance windows
## **Additional Information:**
Expected Hiring Range: $54,800 to $60,250
**Pay Transparency Disclosure:**
The compensation for this position will be determined based on factors that include available budget, internal equity, and the selected candidate's qualifications, experience, education, and other job-related credentials. This range represents Clark University's good-faith estimate of the expected hiring range at the time of posting consistent with Clark's compensation philosophy and internal alignment.
At Clark University we believe that diversity of experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to a more innovative and productive work environment. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds to join our team and contribute their unique ideas to help us achieve our goals.
Clark University offers a generous benefit package for full and, if applicable, part-time employees that include; paid time off, generous retirement plan, group health and dental insurance, life insurance, and tuition, along with use of many campus amenities. For a complete list of benefits for eligible employees visit [here](https://www.clarku.edu/human-resources/benefits/).
To review the Clark University Police Department Annual Security and Fire Safety Report visit [here](https://www.clarku.edu/offices/university-police/annual-security-and-fire-safety-report/).
## **Application Instructions:**
To be considered for this position, you must submit your credentials online. Create a **Clark University Careers** Account by clicking on the **APPLY NOW** button below. You will be able to upload the following documents, which are required for consideration:
- Resume
- Cover letter
See the [FAQ](https://support.interviewexchange.com/articles/#!candidate/your-career-account) for using our online system. Please contact us if you need assistance applying through this website.
Already have a Clark University Careers Account? [Login to your account](https://clarku.interviewexchange.com/login.jsp) to add documents or update your account.
Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. Salary will be commensurate with skills and experience.
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer.
Clark University participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility in the United States.
A successful background check is required upon acceptance.

The Enterprise Infrastructure End-to-End Testing (ETE) function validates endpoint readiness, stability, user experience, application functionality, and performance across VDI, Azure Persistent VM, Windows laptop, and macOS platforms following monthly patches, security updates, application upgrades, and emergency releases. The team partners with DWS Stakeholders to deliver rapid, evidence-based certification of enterprise endpoints while reducing user-impact risk.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Own and lead enterprise ETE endpoint and VDI assets validation across VDI, vPod, Windows laptops, VDI servers, and macOS following OS patches, security updates, application/agent upgrades, and business releases. Deliver accelerated testing SLAs \ by defining prioritized execution models, entry/exit criteria, automation runbooks, and rapid defect triage workflows. Provide fast, evidence-based release certification including pass/fail status, defect classification, risk assessment, and go/no-go recommendations in collaboration with DWS stakeholders. Drive unified functional, regression, and performance validation using standardized ETE test cases and Login VSI workloads to benchmark user experience, application response, and capacity impact. Design, build, and scale automation frameworks leveraging Python, PowerShell, APIs, and command-line tooling to automate endpoint validation, health checks, application testing, telemetry capture, and evidence generation. Standardize performance and experience validation by tracking CPU, memory, disk, logon time, application response, and Login VSI deltas against baseline metrics. Develop cross-platform validation workflows, including macOS testing for patch readiness, compliance, authentication, application behavior, security agent compatibility, and performance baselining. Perform deep OS and application troubleshooting across Windows environments, including event logs, services, drivers, kernel/CPU scheduling, memory/disk performance, network stack behavior, login delays, and endpoint agent conflicts.Leverage observability platforms (e.g., SysTrack, Login VSI, Event Viewer, PerfMon) to accelerate defect identification, root cause analysis, and impact quantification. Operate patch-cycle command center execution with defined ownership, severity models, escalation paths, and structured communication cadence for compressed release timelines. Establish automation-first, repeatable test execution models to increase coverage, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and eliminate false positives. Identify and escalate critical defects early with actionable telemetry, reproducible evidence, impact scope, and remediation ownership. Deliver leadership-ready reporting and dashboards covering SLA adherence, automation coverage, pass/fail trends, performance impact, defect aging, and enterprise risk exposure Continuously improve the ETE testing ecosystem by driving automation maturity, proactive risk detection, standardized execution, and measurable quality improvements. Ensure audit-ready compliance and control adherence, maintaining documented validation evidence, patch readiness metrics, and vulnerability remediation alignment.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

Minimum of 6+ years of relevant experience Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

8–12+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, endpoint testing, endpoint management, VDI operations, EUC engineering, QA automation, or enterprise technology operations. Hands-on experience validating enterprise endpoints including Windows laptops, VDI, vPod, and macOS devices after patching, application upgrades, security agent updates, and platform changes. Strong Windows operating system troubleshooting knowledge including logs, services, drivers, kernel/CPU behavior, memory/disk performance, networking, profiles, login experience, and endpoint agent interactions. Experience performing functional, regression, application, compatibility, and performance testing using standardized test cases and enterprise testing tools. Hands-on experience with Login VSI or comparable user-experience/performance testing toolsets for virtual desktop or application performance validation. Strong automation experience with Python, with working knowledge of C#, C++, PowerShell, REST/API integration, and command-line automation for endpoint validation and evidence collection. Working knowledge of SCCM/MECM and/or Microsoft Intune patch deployment processes, endpoint readiness models, and post-deployment validation workflows. Basic-to-intermediate application troubleshooting skills, including application launch, functional validation, crash/hang review, dependency validation, and performance symptom analysis. Experience with observability or DEX platforms such as SysTrack/Lakeside, endpoint telemetry, Windows Event Viewer, PerfMon, WMI/CIM, and log analytics is preferred. Mac endpoint validation experience including macOS patching, application validation, security tool compatibility, compliance posture, authentication/login flows, and performance checks is preferred. Ability to lead engineers, assign ownership, coordinate with cross-functional teams, manage priorities during compressed release windows, and produce executive-ready status reporting. This role provides technical support to end-users and collaborates with other IT teams to ensure seamless and efficient operations.

Key responsibilities:
Network administration

Monitor, maintain, and support the local and wide area network infrastructure, including switches, routers, and firewalls.
Assist with network security protocols and tools, including firewall management and VPN setup.
Configure and troubleshoot networking equipment from vendors like SonicWall.
Participate in patching, system installations, and configuration of network devices.
Assist with regular system monitoring, backups, and disaster recovery testing to ensure business continuity.

Systems and server support

Manage and maintain server environments, including virtualized systems using VMware and\or Hyper-V.
Administer and support Microsoft Windows Servers and cloud platforms like Azure and Microsoft 365.
Assist with the implementation and enforcement of IT security policies, access controls, and compliance requirements.

Desktop support

Provide hands-on technical support for desktop and laptop computers, peripherals (printers, scanners), and mobile devices.
Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues reported by end-users via the helpdesk ticketing system.
Perform software installations, updates, and application support for products like Microsoft Office 365.
Manage user accounts, passwords, and permissions within Active Directory and other systems for onboarding and offboarding processes.
Maintain an accurate inventory of all IT assets and manage device lifecycle.

Security and Disaster recovery
· Assist with enforcing cybersecurity controls, managing firewalls, and implementing security policies to protect against threats.
· Participate in disaster recovery planning, conduct backups, and ensure business continuity

Project management:
Assist with planning and executing IT projects, such as network enhancements, system migrations, hardware installs and software integrations.
Documentation and compliance
Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and policies. Conduct audits.
Operational and process improvement

Document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies and provide recommendations for network and system improvements.
Collaborate with vendors and other IT teams to resolve complex issues.

Experience in IT operations or system/network administration, requiring 2–4 years of hands-on experience.

jobs.description:
AllSector Technology is growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, motivated IT professionals to join our team as Level 1 or Level 2 MSP Engineers.

This is not a role where you will spend every day doing the same repetitive tasks. As an L1/L2 Engineer, you will be at the heart of our client operations, providing comprehensive support that blends remote help desk calls with scheduled on-site client assistance. Beyond daily support, you will have the opportunity to directly assist senior engineers with complex client project implementations, gaining valuable real-world experience across a wide range of industries.

We provide an environment designed for growth. You will gain hands-on exposure to the latest IT platforms and technologies, including modern Microsoft Cloud solutions, advanced cybersecurity tools, and emerging automation/AI platforms (like Rewst.io and Copilot).

We are seeking individuals who are passionate about technology, genuinely enjoy problem-solving, and are committed to learning new things every day. While you will be part of a collaborative team, the ideal candidate must also possess the judgment and accountability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.

Responsibilities

While supporting our customers is the core of the position, our engineers are encouraged to become involved in much more than ticket resolution.

Core Technical Support:

Provide friendly, timely, and expert remote and onsite technical support to AllSector managed services clients.Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Windows desktop/server environments, hardware, applications, and peripherals.Support Microsoft 365 applications, Exchange Online, and core Azure/Intune services.Manage user accounts, permissions, and access issues within Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.Resolve networking, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall, and connectivity issues.Utilize RMM and monitoring platforms to proactively respond to alerts and investigate potential client issues before they escalate.Communicate clearly and professionally with customers regarding ticket status, updates, and resolutions.Maintain accurate and detailed documentation in IT Glue and create/update ConnectWise service tickets.

Projects & Advanced Initiatives:

Assist senior engineers with client technology projects, such as Microsoft 365 migrations and infrastructure upgrades.Participate in internal technology, automation, and AI initiatives.Help test new scripts, workflows, software integrations, and plugins in real-world environments.Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks using platforms like Rewst.io.

Qualifications

We do not expect candidates to be experts in every technology listed below, but you must demonstrate a strong technical aptitude and a genuine desire to learn and research unfamiliar technologies.

Company-Wide Requirements:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with both technical and non-technical users.Strong troubleshooting skills with a proactive, analytical approach to problem-solving.The ability to prioritize effectively and work well both independently and within a collaborative team environment.High standards for accountability, professional judgment, and quality documentation.

Education & Professional Development:

College degrees and industry certifications are a plus, but equivalent hands-on experience, home labs, and technical projects are valued equally.We invest in you: AllSector Technology promotes continuous learning. We provide study materials, access to training platforms, and full financial support for relevant certification exams and courses for our staff.

Position-Specific Experience Levels:

Level 1 EngineerExperience: 0–2+ years in professional IT.Technical Foundation: Solid understanding of desktop and end-user support, Windows 10/11 troubleshooting, Microsoft 365 fundamentals, basic Active Directory/Entra ID knowledge, and core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPNs).

Level 2 EngineerExperience: 2–5+ years in professional IT (previous MSP or multi-client support experience preferred).Advanced Skills: Advanced Windows desktop troubleshooting and Windows Server administration; proficiency in Microsoft 365/Azure administration, Intune, and Group Policy; comprehensive understanding of networking (VLANs, firewalls, complex troubleshooting) and experience with RMM, Backup, and Endpoint Security platforms.

Why Join AllSector? Beyond Standard IT Support.

AllSector Technology is building something different. We believe an MSP should not only provide exceptional technology services to its customers — it should also create an environment where its employees can learn, experiment, contribute ideas, and build meaningful, long-term careers.

We are looking for ambitious candidates who want to grow with us as we expand. We aren't just maintaining legacy systems; we are actively innovating and operating at the intersection of modern IT services and software development.

When you join AllSector, you become part of an organization that is pushing boundaries:

We are Innovators & Developers: We don't just use other people's tools; we build our own. We have already developed and launched two proprietary software applications listed on The Tech Tribe and the ConnectWise Marketplace, with several more exciting apps currently in development. You will have a front-row seat to our internal software development and QA processes.

We are Impact-Driven (FCC, E-Rate, & Center4.com): We believe in helping those who help our communities. We are proud to hold a 498SPIN ID in the FCC Rural Healthcare program, helping eligible nonprofits secure subsidies upward of 65% off eligible technology costs. We are also registered providers in the E-Rate program, supporting schools and libraries. Furthermore, our Center4.com initiative acts as a technology entitlement think tank, providing nonprofits with vital information and free resources (templates, guides, E-books) to save them time and money.

We are Security-First: As a CISSP-Led IT Solutions Provider, we prioritize security in everything we do. You will gain exposure to enterprise-grade security frameworks and CISSP-backed offerings that set us apart from competitors.

Our Culture of Growth: We foster a culture of curiosity, continuous improvement, and teamwork. We celebrate new ideas, promote from within, and provide the training, mentorship, and financial backing you need to achieve your career goals—whether that's becoming a Senior Engineer, a Cybersecurity Specialist, an Automation Architect, or a Product Lead.

If you are looking for an IT position where you can do more than simply answer support calls and close tickets, we want to hear from you. If you want exposure to the absolute cutting edge of managed services, automation, AI, and proprietary software development, AllSector Technology offers an environment where you can build a remarkable future.

Ready to help us build the next generation of managed IT services?

Apply Today: Please submit your resume and a brief introduction to JoinUs@AllSector.com.

Overview

About Susquehanna

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm founded by a group of friends who share a passion for game theory and probabilistic thinking. We have incorporated this approach into our culture, where you will find relentless problem solvers within each of our core disciplines: Trading, Technology, and Quantitative Research. From offices around the world, our employees collaborate to make optimal decisions and are driven by the desire to achieve winning results together.

What we do

We are experts in trading essentially all listed financial products and asset classes, with a focus on derivatives trading. Through market making and market taking, we handle millions of trading transactions around the world every day, providing liquidity and ensuring competitive prices for buyers and sellers. While our presence in the market is broad, our trading desks are highly specialized, allowing for a deep understanding of unique drivers of each asset class.

Team Overview:

Our Platform Services team is an integral part of the Compute and Storage Platforms (CASP) team at Susquehanna and shares responsibility for building and managing all 15,000+ servers and 250+ PB of storage that composes our critical trade focused infrastructure. Joining Platform Services is the first step in building an engineering career with Susquehanna and provides you with opportunities to:

Rotate across technology spaces

As part of the team, you will be able to rotate with senior engineers specializing in Windows, Linux, Virtualization, Storage, and open source technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Ansible, and Grafana. During these rotations you will partner with engineers to learn the fundamentals of their spaces and help them solve complex problems from building out new environments, evaluating and creating new applications, performance tuning, automation, and configuration management.

Work with mentors

In each rotation you will be paired with one or more mentors that will guide you through your technical growth and Susquehanna's environment. In addition to dealing with day-to-day project work, together you will pinpoint your areas of interest and avenues for growth. You will also work closely with the rest of our teams through design/white board sessions, problem solving discussions, and ongoing project and team updates.

Address and solve challenging technical problems

At Susquehanna we want your help to solve challenging problems! Partner with technologists across Susquehanna's environment to troubleshoot application, network, hardware, and other issues while learning and debating the best solution to fit the scenario. You will have the freedom to test and implement your solutions at scale in our onsite labs consisting of over 600 physical and virtual servers.

Engage with bleeding edge technology

Susquehanna is always looking at the latest technology to see where we can increase speed and performance for competitive advantage while managing risk and enhancing stability. You may have the opportunity to help test out new hardware that isn’t generally available (server hardware, network cards, flash storage), work on emerging platforms geared toward container orchestration (Kubernetes, Service Fabric), or work on high performance clustered environments responsible for driving our quantitative trading.

The shift for this role rotates daily between three shifts: 7:00am-4:00pm(Production Lead), 9:00am-6:00pm and 11:00am-8:00pm(Late Support). There is one Production Lead and Late Support per day and the rest of the team works 9:00am-6:00pm. Applicants must be willing to work these shifts

What we're looking for

BS in Information Technology, Computer Science or Engineering, or a similar technical major.Knowledge of computer architecture, OS and network concepts.A passion for technology, learning, and finding creative ways to solve hard problems.Strong personal initiative and excellent communication skills.Experience with any of the following a plus: Python, PowerShell, Bash, Linux, Windows, building computer systems or networks.Visa sponsorship is available for this position.

As a member of Okta’s Technology Data and Intelligence Engineering Services group, you'll play a critical role in the secure management of Windows-based endpoints across both commercial and federally regulated environments (GovCloud).

Manage and secure Windows devices across our global fleet:

Physical Windows PCs
Windows 365 Cloud PCs
Amazon WorkSpaces

Design, build, and maintain VDI images and pipelines — delivering compliant environments that meet federal standards.
Partner with Security and Compliance to implement and automate frameworks (CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs).
Automate device and identity management with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Okta downstream integrations.
Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub Actions, Microsoft Graph API, AWS Lambda) to build and maintain scalable client platforms.
Deploy and patch applications using modern package management (Patch My PC, Chocolatey, Winget, PSADT).

Build CI/CD workflows and automation that provision, de-provision, and integrate devices with enterprise systems.
Act as a senior escalation point for Windows + VDI, while helping raise the bar with automation-first solutions.

Hands-on scripting with PowerShell, Python, or Go for automation and remediation.
Experience working directly with APIs (Microsoft Graph, REST, AWS, Okta) to integrate and extend platform functionality.
Ability to parse and manipulate JSON objects and extract key-value pairs for use in automation workflows.
Ability to build custom tooling, pipelines, and automation frameworks that interact with APIs for device management, compliance reporting, and security enforcement.
Comfort debugging, documenting, and maintaining API-driven workflows at scale.
A modern approach to endpoint management: automation-first, code-driven, and cloud-oriented.
Experience managing Windows + VDI environments (Windows 365, AWS WorkSpaces, RDS, Citrix, etc.) in regulated industries.
Strong knowledge of identity platforms (Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta, SAML, SCIM, OAuth).
Proven ability to build pipelines and automation with Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD workflows, and cloud services.
Experience with device provisioning and lifecycle management (Intune, Autopilot).
Familiarity with AWS, AWS GovCloud, Azure, and automation tooling (AWS CLI, AWS Lambda, Microsoft Graph).
Strong documentation practices and a collaborative mindset.
Problem-solver who thrives on connecting systems together with automation and glue code.

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

Experience with Jamf Pro, AutoPkg, or Munki (cross-platform endpoint management).
Proficiency in Go, Swift, or other compiled languages for deeper automation.
Certifications (Okta, Microsoft Endpoint, AWS, Terraform, etc.).
Experience working in federal environments.

SRI Tech Solutions Inc., an IT services and consulting firm with a focus on staffing, project solutions, and product development. Job Title: Digital Workplace Engineer
Location: Kingston, NC
Duration: 12 Months Job Summary:We are seeking a skilled and proactive Digital Workplace Engineer to join our IT team at client's location in Kinston, NC. This role is responsible for the design, deployment, management, and support of all end-user computing devices, collaboration tools, and the overall digital employee experience. The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in end-user technology coupled with a solid understanding of networking principles, IT infrastructure components, and cybersecurity best practices. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the stability, security, and efficient operation of our digital workplace environment while collaborating closely with network, infrastructure, and security teams to enhance productivity and user satisfaction. You will also have to support the users adjust and adapt to the new solutions that will be deployed over the coming months. Key Responsibilities:
End-User Support & Troubleshooting:Provide timely and effective technical support for all desktop, laptop, mobile devices, and associated peripherals, including hardware, software, and collaboration tools.Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), applications, and network connectivity within the digital workplace.Manage user accounts, permissions, and access rights in accordance with security policies, focusing on a seamless user experience. Digital Workplace Technology Management:Image, configure, and deploy new and replacement desktop, laptop, and mobile systems.Manage and maintain endpoint management solutions (e.g., SCCM, Intune, Jamf) for software distribution, patch management, inventory, and policy enforcement.Administer and support collaboration platforms (e.g., Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, video conferencing solutions).Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for digital workplace support, deployment, and management.Network & Infrastructure Understanding:Troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi) impacting end-user devices and digital workplace services.Understand network topologies, VPN configurations, and cloud connectivity to assist in resolving user access problems.Collaborate with network and infrastructure teams on projects and incident resolution impacting the digital workplace and end-user services.Assist in documenting network and infrastructure configurations relevant to digital workplace support.Cybersecurity Focus:Implement and enforce endpoint security policies and configurations (e.g., antivirus, anti-malware, encryption, DLP, MFA) across the digital workplace.Respond to and assist in the remediation of security incidents involving end-user devices and accounts.Educate users on cybersecurity best practices and promote a security-aware culture.Ensure compliance with industry regulations (e.g., aerospace-specific, CMMC if applicable) and company security standards for all digital workplace technologies.Documentation & Reporting:Maintain accurate records of hardware inventory, software licenses, and support activities in the IT service management (ITSM) system.Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and knowledge base articles for digital workplace technologies.Generate reports on digital workplace performance, user satisfaction, and support metrics.Project & Collaboration:Participate in IT projects related to digital workplace upgrades, migrations, new technology implementations, and employee experience initiatives.Work collaboratively with other IT team members, business units, and vendors to deliver effective digital workplace solutions.Champion the adoption of new digital tools and practices to improve productivity and collaboration.
Education & Experience:Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, OR equivalent practical experience.7 years of experience in a desktop support, endpoint engineering, or digital workplace role, preferably within a large enterprise or manufacturing environment.Technical Skills:
Proficiency in supporting and troubleshooting Windows (10/11) and macOS operating systems. iOS and Android experience is a plus.
Experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Jamf).
Strong understanding of Active Directory, Azure AD, Group Policy, and identity and access management (IAM) concepts.
Experience with Microsoft 365 suite administration (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online).Networking: Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and wireless networking concepts. Ability to perform basic network troubleshooting.Infrastructure: Familiarity with server virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), cloud services (e.g., Azure, AWS), and general IT infrastructure components.Cybersecurity: Knowledge of endpoint security principles, antivirus/anti-malware solutions, data encryption, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and incident response basics. Familiarity with security frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, CMMC) is a plus.Experience with scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bash) for automation of digital workplace tasks is desirable.Familiarity with ITIL or other ITSM frameworks.Soft Skills:
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with an ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
Customer-focused with a dedication to providing a high-quality digital employee experience.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a collaborative environment.
Proactive, self-motivated, and eager to learn new technologies and improve processes.
Ability to manageDeliverables include but are not limited to:
Optimized Endpoint Deployment Process
Enhanced M365 Collaboration Guide
Endpoint Security Compliance Report
Knowledge Base Expansion
Deployment Plan and Instructions
Operating Model and Instructions
Training Plans and User Manuals SRI Tech Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, national origin or citizenship status or ethnic origin, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other occupationally irrelevant criteria.

jobs.description:
Functional Support Specialist Senior - SMS Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Instructional Designer Sector: Space & Mission Systems

Req #: 125675BR

Location: Westminster, Colorado, United States

Physical Location: Hybrid

Travel Percentage: <10%

Clearance Level - Must Be Able to Obtain: Secret

Clearance Level - Must Currently Possess: None

U.S. Person Required: Yes

U.S. Citizenship Required: Yes

Is Relocation Available: No

BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) IT is seeking an experienced and creative Instructional Designer to join our Business Enablement and Digital Experience team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the digital employee experience by designing engaging, effective learning experiences that empower our workforce and reduce digital fiction. The successful candidate will utilize their technical writing and instructional design expertise to develop innovative learning solutions that align with business objectives and foster continuous learning. The ideal candidate will have a background in writing, graphic design, training design and development, excellent communication skills, and a passion for adult learning and knowledge transfer.

The Operations Strategic Capabilities Unit plays a fundamental role in enabling efficient business and program execution – from strategic capital investments, industrial operations and an efficient supply chain, to state-of-the-art manufacturing and test operations and top-notch facilities management.

What You’ll Do: Create engaging written materials, interactive learning solutions, including digital learning, virtual instructor‑led training (vILT), micro‑learning, videos, and supporting documentation. Design activities and assessments that promote hands‑on and experiential learning. Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) and stakeholders to gather content, review technical information, and translate complex topics into clear and concise materials. Analyze content and learning needs by conducting needs assessments and audience analysis to identify learning objectives and appropriate strategies. Author, maintain, and update varying materials to enhance the employee digital experience such as e‑learning modules, “how‑to” guides, best practice documents, videos, and graphics, utilizing real‑time training evaluation data to inform ongoing maintenance and design needs. Leverage organizational change management (OCM) practices (i.e. ADKAR) to support SMS IT projects and initiatives and lead community of practice forums. Optimize the New Hire and Rehire experience by providing detailed guidance on hardware configuration, essential software, and a comprehensive roadmap for navigating SMS IT support services. Create training solutions using instructional design tools such as Articulate, Vyond, Canva, Camtasia, SharePoint, and similar technologies. Stay abreast of industry trends, innovations, and emerging technologies in graphic and instructional design and digital learning to continually enhance the effectiveness of learning solutions. Proactively revise content as the company products and internal processes evolve. Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of our Learning Management Systems (LMS), including its features, functionality, and best practices. Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule. Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment. Perform other duties as necessary. On‑Site Work Environment: This position requires regular in‑person engagement by working on‑site three or more days each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non‑company locations may be required.

Working Conditions: Work is performed in an office environment, laboratory, cleanroom, or production floor.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills: BS/BA in related field plus 4 or more years related experience. Each higher‑level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education. Proficiency in instructional design tools: Articulate, Vyond, Canva, Camtasia, SharePoint, and similar technologies. Familiarity with the M365 ecosystem (Teams, SharePoint) and engineering collaboration tools. Deep understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE, SAM). Experience managing the full lifecycle of learning programs, from needs assessment and audience analysis to delivery and evaluation. Portfolio or samples of previous instructional design work showcasing a variety of learning solutions and multimedia assets. Track record in designing and managing in‑person and hybrid talent development programming at a variety of levels: individual contributor, supervisor, and mid‑level leaders. A passion for continuous learning and stay up‑to‑date with industry trends, best practices, and new technologies in instructional design and e‑learning. Knowledge of User Experience (UX) and User Interface (UI) design principles as they apply to digital learning and navigation. Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment. Ability to leverage LMS data and support ticket trends to inform training design. Experience with LMS maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present to audiences. Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills: Skilled in utilizing generative AI and effective prompting techniques to optimize course development, communications, and training delivery. Experience supporting Information Technology training and development. Experience utilizing Organizational Change Management (OCM) practices (i.e. ADKAR) to drive tool adoption and reduce user friction. Pay Information: Full‑Time Salary Range: $82,779 – $140,723

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well‑being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non‑monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems: BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, Space & Mission Systems is a leading provider of national defense and civil space applications, advanced remote sensing, scientific and tactical systems for government and commercial customers. We continually pioneer ways to innovate spacecraft, mission payloads, optical systems, and other defense and civil capabilities. Powered by endlessly curious people with an unwavering mission focus, we continually discover ways to enable our customers to perform beyond expectation and protect what matters most.

Security Clearance: A security clearance or access with Polygraph is not required to be eligible for this position. However, the applicant must be willing and eligible for submission, depending on program requirements, after an offer is accepted and must be able to maintain the applicable clearance/access.

This position will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified. Multiple positions may be available on this opening.

jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission‑critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. The Role Kyndryl Consult is the fastest growing business within the organization and instrumental to the company’s strategic growth objectives. You will play a key leadership role across multi‑disciplinary teams, guiding them through complex consulting engagements and be responsible for creating and positioning strategic change agendas within Kyndryl\'s largest accounts across the C‑suite, spanning the intersection between complex Business and IT customer solutions, transformations that impact across the entire customer Eco‑system. This role is focused on delivering digital modernization through Digital Workplace Services (DWS), helping Kyndryl’s M&E (Manufacturing and Engineering) clientele enhance their internal employee experience, workforce agility, collaboration, and overall digital experience. As a Consult Partner, you will have a pivotal role in driving profitable growth, leveraging our comprehensive capabilities to build strong client relationships, and leading your team to success. This role demands a strong presence, industry expertise, and the ability to cultivate relationships with CXO‑level clients. Your leadership will be critical in fostering talent development and innovation within the organization. This role will also be leading the overall client engagement and delivering high quality client work alongside senior client stakeholders. Working in a transaction environment which may be pre or post deal, planning post deal implementation, and ultimately supporting execution. Partners will be focused on financial impact, utilisation and contribution, client impact and leadership. Contribute to Profitable Growth Drive significant financial outcomes through signings and revenue targets Ensure sustained growth and profitability, managing margin expectations and backlog growth Support the identification, pursuit and conversion of a pipeline of business development opportunities Undertake scoping and fee negotiation on engagements, while enduring profitability and understanding and containing risk Apply consultative judgement to accurately scope work, negotiate fees, and draft Statements of Work (SOWs) that align with client needs and enable rapid delivery. Leverage a proven track record of consulting and selling digital workplace services, managing large client portfolios and driving revenue growth. Client Engagement Build and maintain deep relationships with client CXOs and be seen as the \'go to\' person and a trusted advisor by senior executives Leading C‑level client interactions and consulting initiatives, deliverables and outputs of a deal engagement Demonstrate credibility and experience to advise and deliver on complex consulting engagement Enhance client satisfaction, as measured by Net Promoter Score (NPS) and new relationship development; Secure client references Demonstrate a deep understanding of discovery, design, and deployment processes to guide clients through digital workplace transformations. Utilise industry and technology expertise to shape and drive the company’s strategic initiatives. Align with Kyndryl’s strategic vision and contribute to its execution. Drive external eminence and innovation, establishing a strong personal and organisational brand in the industry. Proactively develop thought leadership and intellectual capital Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID‑19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID‑19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritises customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. jobs.title: End User Computing (EUC) Engineer
jobs.summary: Company Overview Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations &...
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced End User Computing (EUC) Engineer to provide dedicated, full-time support. This role will serve as the primary resource responsible for the administration, support, optimization, and security of the organization's end-user computing environment.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across modern endpoint management technologies and a proven track record of managing enterprise desktop environments, mobile devices, and endpoint security initiative

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Mobile Engineer (Intune Engineer)

Location(S): Onshore, SI Office: Alpharetta, GA; Charlotte, NC; Chicago, IL; Colorado Springs, CO; Conshohocken, PA; Dallas, TX; Denver, CO; Fargo, ND; Garden City, NY; Houston, TX; Jacksonville, IL; Lenexa, KS; Los Angeles, CA; Lubbock, TX; Morristown, NJ; Mt Juliet, TN; New York, NY; Purchase, NY; Topeka, KS

Duration: Long term Visa: USC, GC, H1B

Role Summary

Core Role & Responsibilities

Primary Responsibility:

Manage mobile devices using Microsoft Intune (MDM/MEM).Must have strong, hands-on Intune experience—not at a beginner or intermediate level.Will manage mobile device policies, enrollments, integrations (e.g., M&A activities), and platform support.Responsible for both iOS and Android device management, including troubleshooting and support.Strategic Ownership:

Develop and execute a mobile device roadmap.This roadmap should align with the organization's desktop management strategy.Needs to map out the vision for 3–5 years into the future.Environment Scale:

Currently managing ~3,500 mobile devices (approx. 3,200 Android and 300 iOS).This number is expected to grow due to company integrations.Skills & Experience Required

Mandatory:

Minimum 3 years of solid Intune experience, with the ability to clearly speak about configuration, implementation, and troubleshooting.Deep understanding of mobile device management (MDM), particularly using Intune.Should be able to build and present a mobile roadmap.Must know mobile device integration, rollout, and policy enforcement.Ability to clearly explain processes and not just give definitions from memory or AI-enhanced resumes.Preferred / Nice to Have:

Experience with mobile application development (iOS/Android) is a plus, not a requirement.They're not currently developing mobile apps but may begin to in 2026.Having someone with foundational experience in mobile app dev could be helpful for future expansion.Manager Notes – Mobile Engineer Role Discussion:

The original requirement included some level of application development. This has now been removed. Application development is only a plus, not a requirement. Candidates should not be positioned as application developers. If we do that, they won't be chosen.

The focus is on hiring a Mobile Engineer with strong mobile device management experience (Android/iOS). Experience in supporting, configuring, and managing devices is required.

Application developers looking for a change are not a fit. This role is not about developing apps but about device management, compliance, and endpoint support.

The engineer will work on:

Endpoint/device management across Android and iOS.Supporting corporate applications on devices.Ensuring compliance with FDA and other regulatory requirements.Handling PHI (Protected Health Information) policies and corporate security.Managing upgrades, updates, and rollouts across devices.Previous interviews: many candidates were focused on mobile app development, which is not relevant here. Those with limited device management experience were not selected. A few candidates were stronger, but overall, the pool needs to shift more toward device management expertise.

Going forward, sourcing should be focused strictly on Mobile Engineers with hands-on device management background. Application development is optional and only considered an added advantage.

About the position

The candidate will provide support for System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), software package creation, and software deployments. This position will develop and maintain a common client image for IT groups, primarily focused on IT groups supporting clinical systems. The candidate will collaborate with application support teams, infrastructure groups and departmental IT staff to test, deliver, and maintain software installation packages. The candidate should have knowledge of command-line, VB, and/or PowerShell Scripting, WMI, operating system event logging and client troubleshooting. The candidate must have an impeccable attention to details and have a strong desire to explore new ideas and continually learn. The candidate should possess strong technical writing skills. An understanding of ITIL processes or ITIL foundations certification is desired. Excellent verbal and written communication, customer service skills, and a highly collaborative approach is essential to the success of this position. In accordance with institutional policies and standards, the Systems Engineer is responsible for administration, programming, maintenance, performance, implementation, security and support of various departmental and enterprise wide platforms, including the installation and testing of new software, operating systems, related utilities/services, and hardware products as well as the integration of new products and /or software release upgrades into the current environment. Conducts systems performance evaluations, monitoring, patch management and security evaluations. Analyzes user needs in various computer environments (including but not limited to mainframe, Windows, and mid-range) and makes recommendations for products and services that meet those needs. Ensures that all systems environments are maintained in an efficient and cost-effective manner. Projects often require interaction with various departments and teams both within and outside the department. This position will be responsible for meeting with technical staff from many Johns Hopkins IT entities to determine customer needs for the software installation packages. This position’s role is to develop and maintain software installation packages and processes to be used by the Johns Hopkins computing environment. This position is responsible for having expertise in SCCM, along with other software deployment techniques, and providing documentation to the Institutional IT groups around software installations. It is expected that the candidate will be a self-starter and will act independently (with minimal supervision) in representing IT@Johns Hopkins. Work assignments typically come from the Enterprise Management, Monitoring and Security (EMMS) customers, where their satisfaction in task completion is critical. Assignments may also come from members of the EMMS team or ETS management. By utilizing available client imaging technologies, this position will develop and maintain software installation packages for over 500 software catalog items, deployed across more than 60,000 client systems. The scale is “big-E” Enterprise. All Hopkins affiliates, including international locales. Users: 100,000+ Systems: 100,000+ Complexity is at the highest.

Responsibilities
